"""Readout check in "continuing-data mode" (user request, Nov 1 2026).

The 7 data qubits are treated as live through the final measurement layer, as if
they continue into the escape stage. Every flag / ancilla measurement in that
final layer then conflicts with any data qubit on the same readout line r + c.
Mid-circuit conflicts are unchanged (constraints.check_circuit, strict).

    .venv/bin/python -m nnflags.continuing_data
"""

import glob
import json
from pathlib import Path

import stim

from nnflags import constraints as C
from nnflags.willow import readout_line

MEASURES = {"M", "MX", "MY", "MR", "MRX", "MRY"}


def data_qubits(inner: stim.Circuit) -> set[int]:
    return {t.value for inst in inner if inst.name == "MPP" for t in inst.targets_copy()
            if t.is_x_target or t.is_y_target or t.is_z_target}


def final_layer_measured(inner: stim.Circuit) -> set[int]:
    """Qubits measured in the last TICK that contains a measurement."""
    layers, cur = [], []
    for inst in inner.flattened():
        if inst.name == "TICK":
            layers.append(cur)
            cur = []
        else:
            cur.append(inst)
    layers.append(cur)
    for layer in reversed(layers):
        meas = {t.value for inst in layer if inst.name in MEASURES for t in inst.targets_copy()}
        if meas:
            return meas
    return set()


def continuing_data_conflicts(inner: stim.Circuit) -> list[dict]:
    emb = {q: (int(a), int(b)) for q, (a, b) in C.native_coords(inner).items()}
    data = data_qubits(inner)
    measured = final_layer_measured(inner) - data
    out = []
    for m in sorted(measured):
        for d in sorted(data):
            if readout_line(emb[m]) == readout_line(emb[d]):
                out.append(dict(measured=m, measured_at=emb[m], data=d, data_at=emb[d],
                                line=readout_line(emb[m])))
    return out


def run():
    files = sorted(glob.glob("results/zz/success*.inner.stim"))
    files += ["results/g4/G4-CX.inner.stim", "results/g4/G4-native_CZH.inner.stim"]
    report = {}
    for f in files:
        inner = stim.Circuit.from_file(f)
        emb = {q: (int(a), int(b)) for q, (a, b) in C.native_coords(inner).items()}
        conf = continuing_data_conflicts(inner)
        mid = C.check_circuit(inner, emb)  # strict, default live rule and final-layer condition
        name = Path(f).name.replace(".inner.stim", "")
        report[name] = dict(continuing_data_conflicts=conf, n=len(conf), strict_default_violations=len(mid),
                            final_layer_measured=sorted(final_layer_measured(inner) - data_qubits(inner)))
        print(f"{name:22s} continuing-data conflicts: {len(conf)}  "
              + ", ".join(f"q{c['measured']}{c['measured_at']} vs data {c['data']}{c['data_at']} line {c['line']}"
                          for c in conf))
    Path("results/continuing_data.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1, default=str))
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()


def reembed_search(inner: stim.Circuit, limit: int = 200_000):
    """All injective nearest-neighbour Willow embeddings of the circuit's 2-qubit-gate graph
    in which no measured (non-data) qubit shares a readout line with a data qubit,
    i.e. data and measured qubits sit on disjoint readout lines (continuing-data mode)."""
    from nnflags.willow import WILLOW, neighbours
    data = data_qubits(inner)
    qubits = sorted(C.native_coords(inner))
    adj = {q: set() for q in qubits}
    for inst in inner.flattened():
        if inst.name in ("CX", "CZ"):
            t = [x.value for x in inst.targets_copy()]
            for a, b in zip(t[::2], t[1::2]):
                adj[a].add(b)
                adj[b].add(a)
    start = max(qubits, key=lambda q: len(adj[q]))
    order, seen = [start], {start}
    while len(order) < len(qubits):
        nxt = max((q for q in qubits if q not in seen and adj[q] & seen), key=lambda q: len(adj[q] & seen))
        order.append(nxt)
        seen.add(nxt)
    found, pos, used = [], {}, set()

    def ok(q, p):
        line = readout_line(p)
        for o, po in pos.items():
            if (o in adj[q]) and p not in neighbours(po):
                return False
            if (q in data) != (o in data) and readout_line(po) == line:
                return False
        return True

    def rec(i):
        if len(found) >= limit:
            return
        if i == len(order):
            found.append(dict(pos))
            return
        q = order[i]
        placed_nb = [o for o in adj[q] if o in pos]
        cands = set(neighbours(pos[placed_nb[0]])) if placed_nb else set(WILLOW)
        for p in sorted(cands - used):
            if ok(q, p):
                pos[q] = p
                used.add(p)
                rec(i + 1)
                used.discard(p)
                del pos[q]

    rec(0)
    return found


def with_coords(inner: stim.Circuit, emb: dict) -> stim.Circuit:
    out = stim.Circuit()
    for inst in inner:
        if inst.name == "QUBIT_COORDS":
            q = inst.targets_copy()[0].value
            out.append("QUBIT_COORDS", [q], list(emb[q]))
        else:
            out.append(inst)
    return out
"""Hardware-constraint checks for a Stim circuit under an embedding onto Willow.

check_circuit(circuit, embedding) reports
  * unmapped / non-injective / off-grid qubits,
  * two-qubit gates that are not edges of G (non-neighbour),
  * qubits with more than ``max_degree`` distinct two-qubit partners,
  * readout-line conflicts (strict rule, see ``liveness`` / ``readout_violations``),
  * qubits used twice in one TICK.

Conventions (decisions, see RESULTS_steps0-2.md):
  * MPP is the noiseless boundary marker of cliffordea's inner circuits (it
    defines the data qubits), not a hardware operation, so it is ignored by
    the gate checks. Annotations and noise channels are ignored too.
  * Data qubits = cliffordea's ``find_data_indices`` (the MPP targets).
  * "Final layer" = the last TICK that contains a (non-MPP) measurement.
    Measurements in earlier TICKs are mid-circuit (``final_layer="check"``
    checks the final layer too).
  * Readout rule (user's answer, 2026-10-31; replaces the data-only rule of
    Steps 0-2): measuring any qubit dephases its whole r + c line, so every
    other qubit on that line that is live at that TICK is a violation,
    whatever its role. Live intervals: see ``liveness``.
  * Defaults since the Option-1 round (2026-11-01, user decisions 2 and 3):
    ``live_rule="gate"`` (a qubit idling in |0> is not live until its first
    H-like or two-qubit gate) and ``final_layer="auto"`` (final layer exempt
    only if ``final_layer_status`` holds). The Step-3 behaviour is
    ``live_rule="prep", final_layer="exempt"``.
"""
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Literal

import stim

from cliffordea.enum.circuit_tools import split_by_ticks
from cliffordea.enum.circuits._base import find_data_indices

from nnflags.willow import WILLOW, Qubit, is_edge, readout_line

Embedding = dict[int, Qubit]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Violation:
    kind: Literal["unmapped", "not_injective", "off_grid", "non_neighbour",
                  "degree", "readout", "reuse_in_tick"]
    detail: dict = field(hash=False, compare=False)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.kind}: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in self.detail.items())


def _hardware_ops(layer: stim.Circuit):
    """Yield (name, qubit targets) of the hardware operations in one TICK."""
    for op in layer:
        if isinstance(op, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
            raise ValueError("Repeat blocks not supported.")
        if op.name == "MPP":
            continue
        gd = stim.gate_data(op.name)
        if gd.is_noisy_gate and not gd.produces_measurements or op.name.startswith("HERALDED"):
            continue
        if not (gd.is_unitary or gd.is_reset or gd.produces_measurements):
            continue  # annotations such as QUBIT_COORDS, DETECTOR
        qubits = [t.value for t in op.targets_copy() if t.is_qubit_target]
        if qubits:
            yield op.name, qubits, gd


def two_qubit_gates(circuit: stim.Circuit) -> list[tuple[int, str, int, int]]:
    """All two-qubit gate instances as (tick, name, q1, q2)."""
    out = []
    for tick, layer in enumerate(split_by_ticks(circuit)):
        for name, qubits, gd in _hardware_ops(layer):
            if gd.is_two_qubit_gate:
                out += [(tick, name, a, b) for a, b in zip(qubits[::2], qubits[1::2])]
    return out


def partners(circuit: stim.Circuit) -> dict[int, set[int]]:
    """Distinct two-qubit-gate partners of each qubit."""
    p: defaultdict[int, set[int]] = defaultdict(set)
    for _, _, a, b in two_qubit_gates(circuit):
        p[a].add(b)
        p[b].add(a)
    return dict(p)


def native_coords(circuit: stim.Circuit) -> Embedding:
    """QUBIT_COORDS of the circuit as (row, col) (may be half-integer)."""
    return {q: tuple(c) for q, c in circuit.get_final_qubit_coordinates().items()}


LIVE_RULES = ("gate", "prep", "prep_zdormant")
DEFAULT_LIVE_RULE = "gate"
FINAL_LAYER_MODES = ("auto", "exempt", "check")
DEFAULT_FINAL_LAYER = "auto"


def _resolve_live_rule(live_rule, z_reset_idle):
    """Map the Step-3 ``z_reset_idle`` keyword onto ``live_rule`` (old callers
    that pass ``z_reset_idle`` explicitly keep their old meaning)."""
    if live_rule is not None:
        if live_rule not in LIVE_RULES:
            raise ValueError(f"live_rule must be one of {LIVE_RULES}, not {live_rule!r}")
        return live_rule
    if z_reset_idle is None:
        return DEFAULT_LIVE_RULE
    return {"live": "prep", "not_live": "prep_zdormant"}[z_reset_idle]


def keeps_z_basis(name: str) -> bool:
    """Whether a single-qubit unitary maps Z to +-Z (I, Paulis, S, S_DAG, ...):
    it leaves a qubit idling in |0> (or |1>) in a Z eigenstate, which readout
    dephasing cannot disturb."""
    z = stim.Tableau.from_named_gate(name).z_output(0)
    return str(z)[1:] == "Z"


def liveness(circuit: stim.Circuit, data_qubits=None, *, live_rule=None, z_reset_idle=None):
    """Per-TICK live sets and measurements.

    ``live_rule="gate"`` (DEFAULT since the Option-1 round, user decision 2):
      * A qubit idling in a Z eigenstate is NOT live: at the start of the
        circuit, after R, after MR (it is in |0>), and after a measurement
        without reset (M/MX/MY end its use).
      * It becomes live at its first two-qubit gate or its first single-qubit
        gate that does not keep the Z basis (H, H_YZ, SQRT_X, ...); I, X, Y, Z,
        S, S_DAG keep it dormant (``keeps_z_basis``). It stays live until its
        measurement.
      * RX / RY / MRX / MRY prepare a superposition. On hardware RX = R then H
        in the same slot, so the qubit is live from the end of that TICK (it
        is busy, hence not a victim, during the TICK itself).
      * Data qubits (MPP targets of cliffordea inner circuits) are live from
        the start: they hold the injected state.
    ``live_rule="prep"`` (Step-3 default, RESULTS_step3.md): live from any
      preparation (R*, MR*, or any first gate) to the measurement; MR*/R*
      keep the qubit live.
    ``live_rule="prep_zdormant"`` (Step-3 optional refinement
      ``z_reset_idle="not_live"``): as "prep", but after R / MR the qubit is
      dormant until its next gate (any gate, also I).
    ``z_reset_idle="live"`` / ``"not_live"`` (old keyword) selects "prep" /
      "prep_zdormant" when ``live_rule`` is not given.

    :return (live, measured): ``live[t]`` = qubits that are live during TICK t
        and are not themselves measured or reset in TICK t (they are the
        possible victims of a measurement in TICK t); ``measured[t]`` = qubits
        measured in TICK t.
    """
    rule = _resolve_live_rule(live_rule, z_reset_idle)
    if data_qubits is None:
        data_qubits = find_data_indices(circuit)
    state = set(data_qubits)  # live between TICKs
    live, measured = [], []
    for layer in split_by_ticks(circuit):
        busy, meas, after = set(), set(), set(state)
        for name, qubits, gd in _hardware_ops(layer):
            if gd.produces_measurements or gd.is_reset:
                busy.update(qubits)
                if gd.produces_measurements:
                    meas.update(qubits)
                if gd.is_reset and rule != "prep" and name in ("R", "MR"):
                    after.difference_update(qubits)  # dormant in |0> until a gate
                elif gd.is_reset:  # RX/RY/MRX/MRY (and R/MR under "prep"): live afterwards
                    after.update(qubits)
                else:  # M, MX, MY: not live until the next preparation
                    after.difference_update(qubits)
            elif (rule == "gate" and gd.is_single_qubit_gate
                  and keeps_z_basis(name)):
                pass  # a Z-basis-preserving gate leaves the qubit as it was
            else:  # a gate prepares (or keeps) the qubit
                after.update(qubits)
        gated = after - busy
        live.append(frozenset((state | gated) - busy))
        measured.append(frozenset(meas))
        state = after
    return live, measured


def final_layer_status(circuit: stim.Circuit) -> dict:
    """User decision 3: the final measurement layer is exempt from the readout
    rule only IF all its measurements are simultaneous (one TICK) and any
    basis changes happen before it.

    Final layer = the last TICK containing a (non-MPP) measurement. Checked:
      * ``no_gate_at_or_after``: no unitary gate (any single- or two-qubit
        gate, I included) in that TICK or later, on any qubit. Resets after it
        are allowed (cliffordea's trailing reset layer). MX/MY in the final
        TICK count as "basis change before" (on hardware MX = H, then M).
      * ``simultaneous``: no other measurement after the last unitary gate,
        i.e. the measurements that end the circuit are not split over
        several TICKs.
    :return: {"final_tick", "exempt": bool, "no_gate_at_or_after",
        "simultaneous", "reasons": [...]}.
    """
    meas_ticks, gate_ticks = [], []
    for t, layer in enumerate(split_by_ticks(circuit)):
        for name, qubits, gd in _hardware_ops(layer):
            if gd.produces_measurements:
                meas_ticks.append(t)
            elif not gd.is_reset:
                gate_ticks.append(t)
    if not meas_ticks:
        return dict(final_tick=None, exempt=False, no_gate_at_or_after=True,
                    simultaneous=True, reasons=["no measurements"])
    final = max(meas_ticks)
    last_gate = max(gate_ticks, default=-1)
    no_gate = last_gate < final
    simultaneous = all(t == final for t in meas_ticks if t > last_gate)
    reasons = []
    if not no_gate:
        reasons.append(f"unitary gate in TICK {last_gate} >= final measurement TICK {final}")
    if not simultaneous:
        reasons.append("final measurements split over TICKs "
                       f"{sorted({t for t in meas_ticks if t > last_gate})}")
    return dict(final_tick=final, exempt=no_gate and simultaneous,
                no_gate_at_or_after=no_gate, simultaneous=simultaneous, reasons=reasons)


def readout_violations(circuit, embedding, data_qubits=None, *, final_layer=None,
                       live_rule=None, z_reset_idle=None):
    """Strict readout-line rule.

    Measuring any qubit dephases its whole readout line (r + c). At every
    mid-circuit measurement of qubit m in TICK t, every other qubit on the
    same line that is live during TICK t is a violation, whatever the roles
    (data / ancilla / flag) of m and the victim. Qubits measured or reset in
    the same TICK are not victims (a simultaneous readout of the line is
    harmless to them).

    ``final_layer``:
      * ``"auto"`` (DEFAULT, user decision 3): the last TICK containing a
        measurement is exempt only if ``final_layer_status`` says so;
        otherwise it is checked like any other.
      * ``"exempt"``: unconditionally exempt (first-ex.md / Step-3 default).
      * ``"check"``: always checked.
    ``live_rule`` / ``z_reset_idle``: see ``liveness`` (default "gate").
    """
    final_layer = DEFAULT_FINAL_LAYER if final_layer is None else final_layer
    if final_layer not in FINAL_LAYER_MODES:
        raise ValueError(f"final_layer must be one of {FINAL_LAYER_MODES}, not {final_layer!r}")
    if data_qubits is None:
        data_qubits = find_data_indices(circuit)
    data_qubits = set(data_qubits)
    live, measured = liveness(circuit, data_qubits, live_rule=live_rule,
                              z_reset_idle=z_reset_idle)
    ticks = [t for t, ms in enumerate(measured) if ms]
    if not ticks:
        return []
    final_tick = ticks[-1]
    exempt = final_layer == "exempt" or (
        final_layer == "auto" and final_layer_status(circuit)["exempt"])
    by_line: defaultdict[int, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
    for q, p in embedding.items():
        by_line[readout_line(p)].append(q)
    out = []
    for t in ticks:
        if t == final_tick and exempt:
            continue
        for m in sorted(measured[t]):
            line = readout_line(embedding[m])
            for v in sorted(by_line[line]):
                if v != m and v in live[t]:
                    out.append(Violation("readout", dict(
                        tick=t, measured=m, measured_at=embedding[m],
                        victim=v, victim_at=embedding[v],
                        victim_role="data" if v in data_qubits else "ancilla/flag",
                        line=line)))
    return out


def check_circuit(
        circuit: stim.Circuit,
        embedding: Embedding,
        *,
        grid: frozenset[Qubit] | None = WILLOW,
        max_degree: int = 4,
        ignore_readout: bool = False,
        data_qubits: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
        readout: Literal["strict", "ignore"] = "strict",
        final_layer: Literal["auto", "exempt", "check"] | None = None,
        z_reset_idle: Literal["live", "not_live"] | None = None,
        live_rule: Literal["gate", "prep", "prep_zdormant"] | None = None,
) -> list[Violation]:
    """Return every constraint violation of ``circuit`` under ``embedding``.

    ``grid=None`` checks geometry only (unit axis-aligned steps between the
    embedded coordinates, e.g. the circuit's own QUBIT_COORDS).
    ``readout="ignore"`` (or the older ``ignore_readout=True``) turns the
    readout-line check off; see ``readout_violations`` for ``final_layer``.
    """
    out: list[Violation] = []
    used = set()
    layers = split_by_ticks(circuit)
    for tick, layer in enumerate(layers):
        count: defaultdict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
        for name, qubits, gd in _hardware_ops(layer):
            for q in qubits:
                count[q] += 1
                used.add(q)
        for q, n in sorted(count.items()):
            if n > 1:
                out.append(Violation("reuse_in_tick", dict(tick=tick, qubit=q, uses=n)))

    missing = sorted(q for q in used if q not in embedding)
    if missing:
        out.append(Violation("unmapped", dict(qubits=missing)))
        return out
    images = [embedding[q] for q in sorted(used)]
    if len(set(images)) != len(images):
        out.append(Violation("not_injective", dict(images=images)))
    if grid is not None:
        for q in sorted(used):
            if embedding[q] not in grid:
                out.append(Violation("off_grid", dict(qubit=q, at=embedding[q])))

    for tick, name, a, b in two_qubit_gates(circuit):
        if not is_edge(embedding[a], embedding[b], grid):
            out.append(Violation("non_neighbour", dict(
                tick=tick, gate=name, pair=(a, b), at=(embedding[a], embedding[b]))))

    for q, ps in sorted(partners(circuit).items()):
        if len(ps) > max_degree:
            out.append(Violation("degree", dict(qubit=q, partner_count=len(ps),
                                                partners=sorted(ps))))

    if readout not in ("strict", "ignore"):
        raise ValueError(f"readout must be 'strict' or 'ignore', not {readout!r}")
    if readout == "strict" and not ignore_readout:
        out += readout_violations(circuit, embedding, data_qubits, final_layer=final_layer,
                                  live_rule=live_rule, z_reset_idle=z_reset_idle)
    return out


def summarize(violations: list[Violation]) -> dict[str, int]:
    s: defaultdict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for v in violations:
        s[v.kind] += 1
    return dict(s)


# ---- embeddings -------------------------------------------------------------

SYMMETRIES = {
    "id": lambda r, c: (r, c),
    "rot90": lambda r, c: (c, -r),
    "rot180": lambda r, c: (-r, -c),
    "rot270": lambda r, c: (-c, r),
    "flip_r": lambda r, c: (-r, c),
    "flip_c": lambda r, c: (r, -c),
    "transpose": lambda r, c: (c, r),
    "antitranspose": lambda r, c: (-c, -r),
}


def grid_embeddings(circuit: stim.Circuit, grid: frozenset[Qubit] = WILLOW, coords=None):
    """All (symmetry, offset, embedding) placing the circuit's integer
    QUBIT_COORDS (or ``coords``) onto ``grid`` by a lattice symmetry plus
    translation. Empty if some coordinates are not integers."""
    coords = native_coords(circuit) if coords is None else coords
    if any(x != int(x) for xy in coords.values() for x in xy):
        return []
    out = []
    for name, f in SYMMETRIES.items():
        moved = {q: tuple(int(x) for x in f(*xy)) for q, xy in coords.items()}
        anchor = min(moved.values())
        for target in sorted(grid):
            dr, dc = target[0] - anchor[0], target[1] - anchor[1]
            emb = {q: (r + dr, c + dc) for q, (r, c) in moved.items()}
            if all(p in grid for p in emb.values()):
                out.append((name, (dr, dc), emb))
    return out


def extend_embedding(circuit, partial: Embedding, grid: frozenset[Qubit] = WILLOW, **kw):
    """Place the circuit qubits missing from ``partial`` on free grid qubits,
    brute force, minimising (non-neighbour gates, total Manhattan length of
    the two-qubit gates, total violations). Intended for a handful of extra
    qubits (e.g. 2 flags)."""
    import itertools
    used = {q for _, qs, _ in (x for layer in split_by_ticks(circuit)
                               for x in _hardware_ops(layer)) for q in qs}
    missing = sorted(used - set(partial))
    free = sorted(grid - set(partial.values()))
    gates = two_qubit_gates(circuit)
    best = None
    for spots in itertools.permutations(free, len(missing)):
        emb = {**partial, **dict(zip(missing, spots))}
        v = check_circuit(circuit, emb, grid=grid, **kw)
        length = sum(abs(emb[a][0] - emb[b][0]) + abs(emb[a][1] - emb[b][1])
                     for _, _, a, b in gates)
        key = (summarize(v).get("non_neighbour", 0), length, len(v), spots)
        if best is None or key < best[0]:
            best = (key, emb, v)
    return best[1], best[2]

tool_use_result.stdout:
"""Readout check in "continuing-data mode" (user request, Nov 1 2026).

The 7 data qubits are treated as live through the final measurement layer, as if
they continue into the escape stage. Every flag / ancilla measurement in that
final layer then conflicts with any data qubit on the same readout line r + c.
Mid-circuit conflicts are unchanged (constraints.check_circuit, strict).

    .venv/bin/python -m nnflags.continuing_data
"""

import glob
import json
from pathlib import Path

import stim

from nnflags import constraints as C
from nnflags.willow import readout_line

MEASURES = {"M", "MX", "MY", "MR", "MRX", "MRY"}


def data_qubits(inner: stim.Circuit) -> set[int]:
    return {t.value for inst in inner if inst.name == "MPP" for t in inst.targets_copy()
            if t.is_x_target or t.is_y_target or t.is_z_target}


def final_layer_measured(inner: stim.Circuit) -> set[int]:
    """Qubits measured in the last TICK that contains a measurement."""
    layers, cur = [], []
    for inst in inner.flattened():
        if inst.name == "TICK":
            layers.append(cur)
            cur = []
        else:
            cur.append(inst)
    layers.append(cur)
    for layer in reversed(layers):
        meas = {t.value for inst in layer if inst.name in MEASURES for t in inst.targets_copy()}
        if meas:
            return meas
    return set()


def continuing_data_conflicts(inner: stim.Circuit) -> list[dict]:
    emb = {q: (int(a), int(b)) for q, (a, b) in C.native_coords(inner).items()}
    data = data_qubits(inner)
    measured = final_layer_measured(inner) - data
    out = []
    for m in sorted(measured):
        for d in sorted(data):
            if readout_line(emb[m]) == readout_line(emb[d]):
                out.append(dict(measured=m, measured_at=emb[m], data=d, data_at=emb[d],
                                line=readout_line(emb[m])))
    return out


def run():
    files = sorted(glob.glob("results/zz/success*.inner.stim"))
    files += ["results/g4/G4-CX.inner.stim", "results/g4/G4-native_CZH.inner.stim"]
    report = {}
    for f in files:
        inner = stim.Circuit.from_file(f)
        emb = {q: (int(a), int(b)) for q, (a, b) in C.native_coords(inner).items()}
        conf = continuing_data_conflicts(inner)
        mid = C.check_circuit(inner, emb)  # strict, default live rule and final-layer condition
        name = Path(f).name.replace(".inner.stim", "")
        report[name] = dict(continuing_data_conflicts=conf, n=len(conf), strict_default_violations=len(mid),
                            final_layer_measured=sorted(final_layer_measured(inner) - data_qubits(inner)))
        print(f"{name:22s} continuing-data conflicts: {len(conf)}  "
              + ", ".join(f"q{c['measured']}{c['measured_at']} vs data {c['data']}{c['data_at']} line {c['line']}"
                          for c in conf))
    Path("results/continuing_data.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1, default=str))
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()


def reembed_search(inner: stim.Circuit, limit: int = 200_000):
    """All injective nearest-neighbour Willow embeddings of the circuit's 2-qubit-gate graph
    in which no measured (non-data) qubit shares a readout line with a data qubit,
    i.e. data and measured qubits sit on disjoint readout lines (continuing-data mode)."""
    from nnflags.willow import WILLOW, neighbours
    data = data_qubits(inner)
    qubits = sorted(C.native_coords(inner))
    adj = {q: set() for q in qubits}
    for inst in inner.flattened():
        if inst.name in ("CX", "CZ"):
            t = [x.value for x in inst.targets_copy()]
            for a, b in zip(t[::2], t[1::2]):
                adj[a].add(b)
                adj[b].add(a)
    start = max(qubits, key=lambda q: len(adj[q]))
    order, seen = [start], {start}
    while len(order) < len(qubits):
        nxt = max((q for q in qubits if q not in seen and adj[q] & seen), key=lambda q: len(adj[q] & seen))
        order.append(nxt)
        seen.add(nxt)
    found, pos, used = [], {}, set()

    def ok(q, p):
        line = readout_line(p)
        for o, po in pos.items():
            if (o in adj[q]) and p not in neighbours(po):
                return False
            if (q in data) != (o in data) and readout_line(po) == line:
                return False
        return True

    def rec(i):
        if len(found) >= limit:
            return
        if i == len(order):
            found.append(dict(pos))
            return
        q = order[i]
        placed_nb = [o for o in adj[q] if o in pos]
        cands = set(neighbours(pos[placed_nb[0]])) if placed_nb else set(WILLOW)
        for p in sorted(cands - used):
            if ok(q, p):
                pos[q] = p
                used.add(p)
                rec(i + 1)
                used.discard(p)
                del pos[q]

    rec(0)
    return found


def with_coords(inner: stim.Circuit, emb: dict) -> stim.Circuit:
    out = stim.Circuit()
    for inst in inner:
        if inst.name == "QUBIT_COORDS":
            q = inst.targets_copy()[0].value
            out.append("QUBIT_COORDS", [q], list(emb[q]))
        else:
            out.append(inst)
    return out
"""Hardware-constraint checks for a Stim circuit under an embedding onto Willow.

check_circuit(circuit, embedding) reports
  * unmapped / non-injective / off-grid qubits,
  * two-qubit gates that are not edges of G (non-neighbour),
  * qubits with more than ``max_degree`` distinct two-qubit partners,
  * readout-line conflicts (strict rule, see ``liveness`` / ``readout_violations``),
  * qubits used twice in one TICK.

Conventions (decisions, see RESULTS_steps0-2.md):
  * MPP is the noiseless boundary marker of cliffordea's inner circuits (it
    defines the data qubits), not a hardware operation, so it is ignored by
    the gate checks. Annotations and noise channels are ignored too.
  * Data qubits = cliffordea's ``find_data_indices`` (the MPP targets).
  * "Final layer" = the last TICK that contains a (non-MPP) measurement.
    Measurements in earlier TICKs are mid-circuit (``final_layer="check"``
    checks the final layer too).
  * Readout rule (user's answer, 2026-10-31; replaces the data-only rule of
    Steps 0-2): measuring any qubit dephases its whole r + c line, so every
    other qubit on that line that is live at that TICK is a violation,
    whatever its role. Live intervals: see ``liveness``.
  * Defaults since the Option-1 round (2026-11-01, user decisions 2 and 3):
    ``live_rule="gate"`` (a qubit idling in |0> is not live until its first
    H-like or two-qubit gate) and ``final_layer="auto"`` (final layer exempt
    only if ``final_layer_status`` holds). The Step-3 behaviour is
    ``live_rule="prep", final_layer="exempt"``.
"""
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Literal

import stim

from cliffordea.enum.circuit_tools import split_by_ticks
from cliffordea.enum.circuits._base import find_data_indices

from nnflags.willow import WILLOW, Qubit, is_edge, readout_line

Embedding = dict[int, Qubit]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Violation:
    kind: Literal["unmapped", "not_injective", "off_grid", "non_neighbour",
                  "degree", "readout", "reuse_in_tick"]
    detail: dict = field(hash=False, compare=False)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.kind}: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in self.detail.items())


def _hardware_ops(layer: stim.Circuit):
    """Yield (name, qubit targets) of the hardware operations in one TICK."""
    for op in layer:
        if isinstance(op, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
            raise ValueError("Repeat blocks not supported.")
        if op.name == "MPP":
            continue
        gd = stim.gate_data(op.name)
        if gd.is_noisy_gate and not gd.produces_measurements or op.name.startswith("HERALDED"):
            continue
        if not (gd.is_unitary or gd.is_reset or gd.produces_measurements):
            continue  # annotations such as QUBIT_COORDS, DETECTOR
        qubits = [t.value for t in op.targets_copy() if t.is_qubit_target]
        if qubits:
            yield op.name, qubits, gd


def two_qubit_gates(circuit: stim.Circuit) -> list[tuple[int, str, int, int]]:
    """All two-qubit gate instances as (tick, name, q1, q2)."""
    out = []
    for tick, layer in enumerate(split_by_ticks(circuit)):
        for name, qubits, gd in _hardware_ops(layer):
            if gd.is_two_qubit_gate:
                out += [(tick, name, a, b) for a, b in zip(qubits[::2], qubits[1::2])]
    return out


def partners(circuit: stim.Circuit) -> dict[int, set[int]]:
    """Distinct two-qubit-gate partners of each qubit."""
    p: defaultdict[int, set[int]] = defaultdict(set)
    for _, _, a, b in two_qubit_gates(circuit):
        p[a].add(b)
        p[b].add(a)
    return dict(p)


def native_coords(circuit: stim.Circuit) -> Embedding:
    """QUBIT_COORDS of the circuit as (row, col) (may be half-integer)."""
    return {q: tuple(c) for q, c in circuit.get_final_qubit_coordinates().items()}


LIVE_RULES = ("gate", "prep", "prep_zdormant")
DEFAULT_LIVE_RULE = "gate"
FINAL_LAYER_MODES = ("auto", "exempt", "check")
DEFAULT_FINAL_LAYER = "auto"


def _resolve_live_rule(live_rule, z_reset_idle):
    """Map the Step-3 ``z_reset_idle`` keyword onto ``live_rule`` (old callers
    that pass ``z_reset_idle`` explicitly keep their old meaning)."""
    if live_rule is not None:
        if live_rule not in LIVE_RULES:
            raise ValueError(f"live_rule must be one of {LIVE_RULES}, not {live_rule!r}")
        return live_rule
    if z_reset_idle is None:
        return DEFAULT_LIVE_RULE
    return {"live": "prep", "not_live": "prep_zdormant"}[z_reset_idle]


def keeps_z_basis(name: str) -> bool:
    """Whether a single-qubit unitary maps Z to +-Z (I, Paulis, S, S_DAG, ...):
    it leaves a qubit idling in |0> (or |1>) in a Z eigenstate, which readout
    dephasing cannot disturb."""
    z = stim.Tableau.from_named_gate(name).z_output(0)
    return str(z)[1:] == "Z"


def liveness(circuit: stim.Circuit, data_qubits=None, *, live_rule=None, z_reset_idle=None):
    """Per-TICK live sets and measurements.

    ``live_rule="gate"`` (DEFAULT since the Option-1 round, user decision 2):
      * A qubit idling in a Z eigenstate is NOT live: at the start of the
        circuit, after R, after MR (it is in |0>), and after a measurement
        without reset (M/MX/MY end its use).
      * It becomes live at its first two-qubit gate or its first single-qubit
        gate that does not keep the Z basis (H, H_YZ, SQRT_X, ...); I, X, Y, Z,
        S, S_DAG keep it dormant (``keeps_z_basis``). It stays live until its
        measurement.
      * RX / RY / MRX / MRY prepare a superposition. On hardware RX = R then H
        in the same slot, so the qubit is live from the end of that TICK (it
        is busy, hence not a victim, during the TICK itself).
      * Data qubits (MPP targets of cliffordea inner circuits) are live from
        the start: they hold the injected state.
    ``live_rule="prep"`` (Step-3 default, RESULTS_step3.md): live from any
      preparation (R*, MR*, or any first gate) to the measurement; MR*/R*
      keep the qubit live.
    ``live_rule="prep_zdormant"`` (Step-3 optional refinement
      ``z_reset_idle="not_live"``): as "prep", but after R / MR the qubit is
      dormant until its next gate (any gate, also I).
    ``z_reset_idle="live"`` / ``"not_live"`` (old keyword) selects "prep" /
      "prep_zdormant" when ``live_rule`` is not given.

    :return (live, measured): ``live[t]`` = qubits that are live during TICK t
        and are not themselves measured or reset in TICK t (they are the
        possible victims of a measurement in TICK t); ``measured[t]`` = qubits
        measured in TICK t.
    """
    rule = _resolve_live_rule(live_rule, z_reset_idle)
    if data_qubits is None:
        data_qubits = find_data_indices(circuit)
    state = set(data_qubits)  # live between TICKs
    live, measured = [], []
    for layer in split_by_ticks(circuit):
        busy, meas, after = set(), set(), set(state)
        for name, qubits, gd in _hardware_ops(layer):
            if gd.produces_measurements or gd.is_reset:
                busy.update(qubits)
                if gd.produces_measurements:
                    meas.update(qubits)
                if gd.is_reset and rule != "prep" and name in ("R", "MR"):
                    after.difference_update(qubits)  # dormant in |0> until a gate
                elif gd.is_reset:  # RX/RY/MRX/MRY (and R/MR under "prep"): live afterwards
                    after.update(qubits)
                else:  # M, MX, MY: not live until the next preparation
                    after.difference_update(qubits)
            elif (rule == "gate" and gd.is_single_qubit_gate
                  and keeps_z_basis(name)):
                pass  # a Z-basis-preserving gate leaves the qubit as it was
            else:  # a gate prepares (or keeps) the qubit
                after.update(qubits)
        gated = after - busy
        live.append(frozenset((state | gated) - busy))
        measured.append(frozenset(meas))
        state = after
    return live, measured


def final_layer_status(circuit: stim.Circuit) -> dict:
    """User decision 3: the final measurement layer is exempt from the readout
    rule only IF all its measurements are simultaneous (one TICK) and any
    basis changes happen before it.

    Final layer = the last TICK containing a (non-MPP) measurement. Checked:
      * ``no_gate_at_or_after``: no unitary gate (any single- or two-qubit
        gate, I included) in that TICK or later, on any qubit. Resets after it
        are allowed (cliffordea's trailing reset layer). MX/MY in the final
        TICK count as "basis change before" (on hardware MX = H, then M).
      * ``simultaneous``: no other measurement after the last unitary gate,
        i.e. the measurements that end the circuit are not split over
        several TICKs.
    :return: {"final_tick", "exempt": bool, "no_gate_at_or_after",
        "simultaneous", "reasons": [...]}.
    """
    meas_ticks, gate_ticks = [], []
    for t, layer in enumerate(split_by_ticks(circuit)):
        for name, qubits, gd in _hardware_ops(layer):
            if gd.produces_measurements:
                meas_ticks.append(t)
            elif not gd.is_reset:
                gate_ticks.append(t)
    if not meas_ticks:
        return dict(final_tick=None, exempt=False, no_gate_at_or_after=True,
                    simultaneous=True, reasons=["no measurements"])
    final = max(meas_ticks)
    last_gate = max(gate_ticks, default=-1)
    no_gate = last_gate < final
    simultaneous = all(t == final for t in meas_ticks if t > last_gate)
    reasons = []
    if not no_gate:
        reasons.append(f"unitary gate in TICK {last_gate} >= final measurement TICK {final}")
    if not simultaneous:
        reasons.append("final measurements split over TICKs "
                       f"{sorted({t for t in meas_ticks if t > last_gate})}")
    return dict(final_tick=final, exempt=no_gate and simultaneous,
                no_gate_at_or_after=no_gate, simultaneous=simultaneous, reasons=reasons)


def readout_violations(circuit, embedding, data_qubits=None, *, final_layer=None,
                       live_rule=None, z_reset_idle=None):
    """Strict readout-line rule.

    Measuring any qubit dephases its whole readout line (r + c). At every
    mid-circuit measurement of qubit m in TICK t, every other qubit on the
    same line that is live during TICK t is a violation, whatever the roles
    (data / ancilla / flag) of m and the victim. Qubits measured or reset in
    the same TICK are not victims (a simultaneous readout of the line is
    harmless to them).

    ``final_layer``:
      * ``"auto"`` (DEFAULT, user decision 3): the last TICK containing a
        measurement is exempt only if ``final_layer_status`` says so;
        otherwise it is checked like any other.
      * ``"exempt"``: unconditionally exempt (first-ex.md / Step-3 default).
      * ``"check"``: always checked.
    ``live_rule`` / ``z_reset_idle``: see ``liveness`` (default "gate").
    """
    final_layer = DEFAULT_FINAL_LAYER if final_layer is None else final_layer
    if final_layer not in FINAL_LAYER_MODES:
        raise ValueError(f"final_layer must be one of {FINAL_LAYER_MODES}, not {final_layer!r}")
    if data_qubits is None:
        data_qubits = find_data_indices(circuit)
    data_qubits = set(data_qubits)
    live, measured = liveness(circuit, data_qubits, live_rule=live_rule,
                              z_reset_idle=z_reset_idle)
    ticks = [t for t, ms in enumerate(measured) if ms]
    if not ticks:
        return []
    final_tick = ticks[-1]
    exempt = final_layer == "exempt" or (
        final_layer == "auto" and final_layer_status(circuit)["exempt"])
    by_line: defaultdict[int, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
    for q, p in embedding.items():
        by_line[readout_line(p)].append(q)
    out = []
    for t in ticks:
        if t == final_tick and exempt:
            continue
        for m in sorted(measured[t]):
            line = readout_line(embedding[m])
            for v in sorted(by_line[line]):
                if v != m and v in live[t]:
                    out.append(Violation("readout", dict(
                        tick=t, measured=m, measured_at=embedding[m],
                        victim=v, victim_at=embedding[v],
                        victim_role="data" if v in data_qubits else "ancilla/flag",
                        line=line)))
    return out


def check_circuit(
        circuit: stim.Circuit,
        embedding: Embedding,
        *,
        grid: frozenset[Qubit] | None = WILLOW,
        max_degree: int = 4,
        ignore_readout: bool = False,
        data_qubits: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
        readout: Literal["strict", "ignore"] = "strict",
        final_layer: Literal["auto", "exempt", "check"] | None = None,
        z_reset_idle: Literal["live", "not_live"] | None = None,
        live_rule: Literal["gate", "prep", "prep_zdormant"] | None = None,
) -> list[Violation]:
    """Return every constraint violation of ``circuit`` under ``embedding``.

    ``grid=None`` checks geometry only (unit axis-aligned steps between the
    embedded coordinates, e.g. the circuit's own QUBIT_COORDS).
    ``readout="ignore"`` (or the older ``ignore_readout=True``) turns the
    readout-line check off; see ``readout_violations`` for ``final_layer``.
    """
    out: list[Violation] = []
    used = set()
    layers = split_by_ticks(circuit)
    for tick, layer in enumerate(layers):
        count: defaultdict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
        for name, qubits, gd in _hardware_ops(layer):
            for q in qubits:
                count[q] += 1
                used.add(q)
        for q, n in sorted(count.items()):
            if n > 1:
                out.append(Violation("reuse_in_tick", dict(tick=tick, qubit=q, uses=n)))

    missing = sorted(q for q in used if q not in embedding)
    if missing:
        out.append(Violation("unmapped", dict(qubits=missing)))
        return out
    images = [embedding[q] for q in sorted(used)]
    if len(set(images)) != len(images):
        out.append(Violation("not_injective", dict(images=images)))
    if grid is not None:
        for q in sorted(used):
            if embedding[q] not in grid:
                out.append(Violation("off_grid", dict(qubit=q, at=embedding[q])))

    for tick, name, a, b in two_qubit_gates(circuit):
        if not is_edge(embedding[a], embedding[b], grid):
            out.append(Violation("non_neighbour", dict(
                tick=tick, gate=name, pair=(a, b), at=(embedding[a], embedding[b]))))

    for q, ps in sorted(partners(circuit).items()):
        if len(ps) > max_degree:
            out.append(Violation("degree", dict(qubit=q, partner_count=len(ps),
                                                partners=sorted(ps))))

    if readout not in ("strict", "ignore"):
        raise ValueError(f"readout must be 'strict' or 'ignore', not {readout!r}")
    if readout == "strict" and not ignore_readout:
        out += readout_violations(circuit, embedding, data_qubits, final_layer=final_layer,
                                  live_rule=live_rule, z_reset_idle=z_reset_idle)
    return out


def summarize(violations: list[Violation]) -> dict[str, int]:
    s: defaultdict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for v in violations:
        s[v.kind] += 1
    return dict(s)


# ---- embeddings -------------------------------------------------------------

SYMMETRIES = {
    "id": lambda r, c: (r, c),
    "rot90": lambda r, c: (c, -r),
    "rot180": lambda r, c: (-r, -c),
    "rot270": lambda r, c: (-c, r),
    "flip_r": lambda r, c: (-r, c),
    "flip_c": lambda r, c: (r, -c),
    "transpose": lambda r, c: (c, r),
    "antitranspose": lambda r, c: (-c, -r),
}


def grid_embeddings(circuit: stim.Circuit, grid: frozenset[Qubit] = WILLOW, coords=None):
    """All (symmetry, offset, embedding) placing the circuit's integer
    QUBIT_COORDS (or ``coords``) onto ``grid`` by a lattice symmetry plus
    translation. Empty if some coordinates are not integers."""
    coords = native_coords(circuit) if coords is None else coords
    if any(x != int(x) for xy in coords.values() for x in xy):
        return []
    out = []
    for name, f in SYMMETRIES.items():
        moved = {q: tuple(int(x) for x in f(*xy)) for q, xy in coords.items()}
        anchor = min(moved.values())
        for target in sorted(grid):
            dr, dc = target[0] - anchor[0], target[1] - anchor[1]
            emb = {q: (r + dr, c + dc) for q, (r, c) in moved.items()}
            if all(p in grid for p in emb.values()):
                out.append((name, (dr, dc), emb))
    return out


def extend_embedding(circuit, partial: Embedding, grid: frozenset[Qubit] = WILLOW, **kw):
    """Place the circuit qubits missing from ``partial`` on free grid qubits,
    brute force, minimising (non-neighbour gates, total Manhattan length of
    the two-qubit gates, total violations). Intended for a handful of extra
    qubits (e.g. 2 flags)."""
    import itertools
    used = {q for _, qs, _ in (x for layer in split_by_ticks(circuit)
                               for x in _hardware_ops(layer)) for q in qs}
    missing = sorted(used - set(partial))
    free = sorted(grid - set(partial.values()))
    gates = two_qubit_gates(circuit)
    best = None
    for spots in itertools.permutations(free, len(missing)):
        emb = {**partial, **dict(zip(missing, spots))}
        v = check_circuit(circuit, emb, grid=grid, **kw)
        length = sum(abs(emb[a][0] - emb[b][0]) + abs(emb[a][1] - emb[b][1])
                     for _, _, a, b in gates)
        key = (summarize(v).get("non_neighbour", 0), length, len(v), spots)
        if best is None or key < best[0]:
            best = (key, emb, v)
    return best[1], best[2]

    assignment).
  Translations and the r+c-line-preserving symmetries (transpose, rot180,
  antitranspose) do not change verify() or the readout rule, and the
  enumeration around a fixed root contains every orientation of every shape,
  so other regions differ only by Willow's boundary (free neighbours).

FILTERS AND FLAGS
  * Hook qubits = qubits carrying the X/Y events of the faults with data
    weight >= 2 in the base's malignant 2-fault T configurations
    (FaultCombinator.index_to_events, enum/combinators/fault_combinator.py:374).

    qubit q, R in the preparation TICK (dormant in |0> until its first CX

"""
import argparse
import csv
import itertools
import json
import time
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from multiprocessing import Pool
from pathlib import Path

import stim

from nnflags import constraints as C
from nnflags import equivalence as Q
from nnflags.g4 import full_for
from nnflags.verify import load_measurement, verify
from nnflags.willow import WILLOW, neighbours, readout_line

CODE_PLAQ = ((0, 1, 2, 3), (1, 2, 4, 5), (2, 3, 5, 6))  # canonical d=3 colour code
CODE_MAJ = (0, 2, 4, 6)   # centre 2 + corners (S targets of logical S)
CODE_MIN = (1, 3, 5)
ROOTS = {1: ((9, 9),), 2: ((9, 9), (8, 10))}
MAX_VALID = 20
INFEASIBLE = 10 ** 6  # marker: labelling breaks the code (no flow S -> S)
NOISE = 1e-3


# ---- code labellings ------------------------------------------------------------

def _stab_supports(plaq):
    out = set()
    for k in range(1, 8):
        s = set()
        for i in range(3):
            if k >> i & 1:
                s ^= set(plaq[i])
        out.add(frozenset(s))
    return out


def code_automorphisms():
    s0 = _stab_supports(CODE_PLAQ)
    return [p for p in itertools.permutations(range(7))
            if {frozenset(p[q] for q in s) for s in s0} == s0 and {p[q] for q in CODE_MAJ} == set(CODE_MAJ)]


def labelling_classes():
    """210 representatives lab (code qubit j -> j-th data node) of 7! / 24."""
    aut = code_automorphisms()
    reps = set()
    for lab in itertools.permutations(range(7)):
        reps.add(min(tuple(lab[a[j]] for j in range(7)) for a in aut))
    return sorted(reps)


# ---- enumeration of forests ---------------------------------------------------------

def connected_sets(roots, n, grid=WILLOW):
    """Redelmeier enumeration of connected vertex sets of size n containing all
    ``roots`` (several roots are treated as one merged start vertex), avoiding
    every other qubit on a root's readout line."""
    lines = {readout_line(r) for r in roots}
    allowed = {p for p in grid if readout_line(p) not in lines} | set(roots)
    nb = {p: [q for q in neighbours(p, grid) if q in allowed] for p in allowed}
    order = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(sorted(allowed))}
    start = set(roots)
    out = []

    def rec(current, untried, forbidden):
        if len(current) == n:
            out.append(frozenset(current))
            return
        untried = list(untried)
        while untried:
            v = untried.pop()
            new = [w for w in nb[v] if w not in forbidden and w not in current]
            rec(current | {v}, untried + new, forbidden | set(new))
            forbidden = forbidden | {v}

    init = sorted({w for r in roots for w in nb[r]} - start, key=order.get)
    rec(start, init, start | set(init))
    return out


def spanning_forests(vertices, roots):
    """Every spanning tree of the induced grid graph with the roots merged =
    every spanning forest whose components each contain exactly one root.
    Yields parent maps {v: parent or None}."""
    vs = sorted(vertices)
    rootset = set(roots)
    merged = lambda p: "R" if p in rootset else p
    edges = sorted({tuple(sorted((a, b))) for a in vs for b in neighbours(a) if b in vertices
                    and not (a in rootset and b in rootset)})
    nodes = {merged(v) for v in vs}
    need = len(nodes) - 1

    def find(par, x):
        while par[x] != x:
            x = par[x]
        return x

    def rec(i, chosen, par):
        if len(chosen) == need:
            yield list(chosen)
            return
        if len(edges) - i < need - len(chosen):
            return
        a, b = edges[i]
        ra, rb = find(par, merged(a)), find(par, merged(b))
        if ra != rb:
            p2 = dict(par)
            p2[ra] = rb
            yield from rec(i + 1, chosen + [(a, b)], p2)
        yield from rec(i + 1, chosen, par)

    for es in rec(0, [], {x: x for x in nodes}):
        adj = defaultdict(list)
        for a, b in es:
            adj[a].append(b)
            adj[b].append(a)
        parent = {r: None for r in roots}
        stack = list(roots)
        while stack:
            v = stack.pop()
            for w in adj[v]:
                if w not in parent:
                    parent[w] = v
                    stack.append(w)
        if len(parent) == len(vs):
            yield parent


def role_assignments(parent, roots):
    """Roots ancilla, leaves data, internal non-root nodes data or ancilla, 7 data."""
    kids = Counter(p for p in parent.values() if p is not None)
    leaves = [v for v in parent if v not in kids and v not in roots]
    internal = sorted(v for v in parent if v in kids and v not in roots)
    need = 7 - len(leaves)
    if need < 0 or need > len(internal):
        return
    for data_int in itertools.combinations(internal, need):
        data = set(leaves) | set(data_int)
        yield {v: ("D" if v in data else "A") for v in parent}


@dataclass
class Base:
    parent: dict      # position -> parent position (None for roots)
    roles: dict       # position -> "D" / "A"
    roots: tuple

    def _kids(self):
        kids = defaultdict(list)
        for v, p in self.parent.items():
            if p is not None:
                kids[p].append(v)
        return kids

    def canon(self):
        """{position: canonical string of its rooted subtree} (AHU encoding with
        roles); isomorphic trees get identical strings."""
        kids, memo = self._kids(), {}

        def c(v):
            if v not in memo:
                memo[v] = self.roles[v] + "(" + ",".join(sorted(c(w) for w in kids[v])) + ")"
            return memo[v]

        for r in self.roots:
            c(r)
        return memo

    def nodes(self):
        """Circuit qubit order = canonical DFS order (roots by canonical string,
        children by canonical string), so isomorphic bases give the same circuit
        up to QUBIT_COORDS and verify() can be cached per isomorphism class."""
        cs, kids = self.canon(), self._kids()
        order = []

        def dfs(v):
            order.append(v)
            for w in sorted(kids[v], key=lambda w: (cs[w], w)):
                dfs(w)

        for r in sorted(self.roots, key=lambda r: (cs[r], r)):
            dfs(r)
        return order

    def abstract_key(self):
        cs = self.canon()
        return tuple(sorted(cs[r] for r in self.roots))

    def describe(self):
        idx = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(self.nodes())}
        parts = []
        for p in self.nodes():
            par = self.parent[p]
            parts.append(f"{idx[p]}{self.roles[p]}{p}" + ("" if par is None else f"<{idx[par]}"))
        return " ".join(parts)


def schedule(parent_idx, roots_idx):
    """ASAP fold: [(tick, parent, child)], depth. Children of a node are eaten
    in order of readiness, ties by index (= canonical order, see Base.nodes)."""
    n = len(parent_idx)
    kids = defaultdict(list)
    for c, p in enumerate(parent_idx):
        if p >= 0:
            kids[p].append(c)
    fin, gates = {}, []

    def f(v):
        if v in fin:
            return fin[v]
        t = 0
        for c in sorted(kids[v], key=lambda c: (f(c), c)):
            t = max(t + 1, f(c) + 1)
            gates.append((t, v, c))
        fin[v] = t
        return t

    for r in roots_idx:
        f(r)
    return sorted(gates), max(fin[r] for r in roots_idx)


# ---- circuit construction ---------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Flag:
    q: int        # control (circuit qubit index)
    at: tuple     # Willow position of the flag
    t1: float     # slot: integer = existing TICK, k + 0.5 = new TICK after TICK k
    t2: float

    def __str__(self):
        return f"q{self.q}->{self.at} t{self.t1:g},{self.t2:g}"


def build(base: Base, flags=()):
    """CX-form inner circuit (no detectors yet) as TICK -> ops, plus layout.
    TICK 0 MPP, 1 RX ancillas (+ R flags), 2..D+1 fold, D+2 MRX roots,
    D+3..2D+2 unfold, 2D+3 MX ancillas (+ M flags), 2D+4 R."""
    nodes = base.nodes()
    idx = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(nodes)}
    parent_idx = [-1 if base.parent[p] is None else idx[base.parent[p]] for p in nodes]
    roots = [idx[r] for r in base.roots]
    data = [i for i, p in enumerate(nodes) if base.roles[p] == "D"]
    anc = [i for i, p in enumerate(nodes) if base.roles[p] == "A"]
    gates, D = schedule(parent_idx, roots)
    ticks = defaultdict(list)  # float slot -> [(name, targets)]
    ticks[0].append(("MPP", data))
    ticks[1].append(("RX", anc))
    for t, a, b in gates:
        ticks[1 + t].append(("CX", [a, b]))
        ticks[2 * D + 3 - t].append(("CX", [a, b]))
    mid, final = D + 2, 2 * D + 3
    ticks[mid].append(("MRX", roots))
    ticks[final].append(("MX", anc))
    ticks[final + 1].append(("R", anc))
    nq = len(nodes)
    emb = {i: p for i, p in enumerate(nodes)}
    fq = []
    for j, fl in enumerate(flags):
        f = nq + j
        fq.append(f)
        emb[f] = fl.at
        ticks[1].append(("R", [f]))
        ticks[fl.t1].append(("CX", [fl.q, f]))
        ticks[fl.t2].append(("CX", [fl.q, f]))
        ticks[final].append(("M", [f]))
        ticks[final + 1].append(("R", [f]))
    return dict(ticks=ticks, emb=emb, data=data, anc=anc, roots=roots, flags=fq, mid=mid,
                final=final, depth=D, gates=gates, nodes=nodes)


def to_circuit(layout) -> stim.Circuit:
    """Stim circuit with detectors: forward check (roots xor MPP), then for each
    final MX / M the smallest deterministic set among {itself, + one root's
    mid record, + all roots' mid records, + MPP} (stim determinism test)."""
    ticks, emb = layout["ticks"], layout["emb"]
    c = stim.Circuit()
    for q in sorted(emb):
        c.append("QUBIT_COORDS", [q], emb[q])
    rec = {}  # (tick, qubit) -> measurement index
    n = 0
    for i, t in enumerate(sorted(ticks)):
        if i:
            c.append("TICK")
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        for name, ts in ticks[t]:
            groups[name] += ts
        for name in sorted(groups, key=lambda x: ("MPP", "RX", "R", "CX", "MRX", "MX", "M").index(x)):
            ts = groups[name]
            if name == "MPP":
                c.append("MPP", [x for q in ts for x in (stim.target_x(q), stim.target_combiner())][:-1])
                rec[("MPP", 0)] = n
                n += 1
            else:
                c.append(name, ts)
                if stim.gate_data(name).produces_measurements:
                    for q in ts:
                        rec[(t, q)] = n
                        n += 1
        if t == layout["mid"]:
            ids = [rec[(t, r)] for r in layout["roots"]] + [rec[("MPP", 0)]]
            c.append("DETECTOR", [stim.target_rec(x - n) for x in ids])
        if t == layout["final"]:
            mids = [rec[(layout["mid"], r)] for r in layout["roots"]]
            for q in layout["anc"] + layout["flags"]:
                m = rec[(t, q)]
                options = [[m]] + [[m, x] for x in mids] + [[m] + mids] + [[m] + mids + [rec[("MPP", 0)]]]
                for ids in options:
                    test = c.copy()
                    test.append("DETECTOR", [stim.target_rec(x - n) for x in ids])
                    if Q.is_deterministic(test):
                        c = test
                        break
    return c


def full_circuit(inner, layout, lab):
    """Full circuit for verify(): plaquettes / sublattices via the labelling
    lab (code qubit j -> data node lab[j])."""
    data = layout["data"]
    L = [data[lab[j]] for j in range(7)]
    return full_for(inner, tuple(tuple(L[j] for j in p) for p in CODE_PLAQ),
                    tuple(L[j] for j in CODE_MAJ), tuple(L[j] for j in CODE_MIN), data)


# ---- workers --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _verify_labelling(args):
    inner_text, layout_light, lab = args
    inner = stim.Circuit(inner_text)
    try:
        full = full_circuit(inner, layout_light, lab)
    except AssertionError:
        # The fold does not preserve the code for this labelling (m = 2: a Z
        # plaquette with odd overlap with one root's component): not a double check.
        return lab, INFEASIBLE, float("inf")
    r = verify(full, inner, max_fault_count=2)
    return lab, r["T"][2]["malignant"], r["error_rate_per_kept_shot"]["T"]


def hooks_of(inner, full, layout):
    """X-hook qubits: qubits carrying X/Y events of the faults with data weight
    >= 2 in the malignant 2-fault T configurations -> {qubit: [event ticks]}."""
    from cliffordea import enum
    m = load_measurement(full, inner)
    comb = enum.FaultCombinator(enum.noise.uniformly_depolarize(m.INNER_CIRCUIT, noise_level=NOISE))
    from cliffordea import accept
    an = accept.CliffordLogicalAnalyzer(data_indices=m.DATA_INDICES,
                                        stabilizer_generators=m.STABILIZER_GENERATORS,
                                        logical_s=m.LOGICAL_S)
    kept = comb.get_kept_effects(logical_analyzer=an, max_fault_count=2, cultivated_states=("T",))
    mal = [cfg for k, eff in enumerate(kept["T"]) for p, fid, cfgs in eff.values()
           if p > 0 and fid != 1 for cfg in cfgs if len(cfg) == 2]
    effect = {i: e for sig, d in comb.basis.items() for e, i in d.items()}
    nq = inner.num_qubits
    data = set(layout["data"])
    weight = lambda e: sum(1 for q in data if (e >> q) & 1 or (e >> (nq + q)) & 1)
    hooks = defaultdict(list)
    for cfg in mal:
        for i in cfg:
            if weight(effect[i]) < 2:
                continue
            evs = comb.index_to_events[i]
            single = [(ev[0], ev[2][0].value) for ev in evs if ev[1] in ("X_ERROR", "Y_ERROR")]
            if not single:
                single = [(ev[0], t.value) for ev in evs if ev[1] == "E" for t in ev[2]
                          if t.is_x_target or t.is_y_target]
            cnt = Counter(q for _, q in single)
            if not cnt:
                continue
            top = max(cnt.values())
            for q, k in cnt.items():
                if k == top:
                    hooks[q] += [t for t, qq in single if qq == q]
    return {q: sorted(set(ts)) for q, ts in hooks.items()}, len(mal)


def q_ops(layout):
    """{qubit: {slot: role}} with role control / target / other."""
    ops = defaultdict(dict)
    for t, items in layout["ticks"].items():
        for name, ts in items:
            if name == "CX":
                ops[ts[0]][t] = "control"
                ops[ts[1]][t] = "target"
            elif name != "MPP":
                for q in ts:
                    ops[q][t] = "other"
    return ops


def flag_options(layout, q, events, used_positions):
    """Best slot pair per free neighbour of q (most hook events covered,
    then fewest added TICKs, then shortest)."""
    ops = q_ops(layout)[q]
    lo, hi = 2, layout["final"] - 1
    slots = [t for t in range(lo, hi + 1) if t not in ops] + [k + 0.5 for k in range(1, hi + 1)]
    best = None
    for t1, t2 in itertools.combinations(sorted(slots), 2):
        if not all(r == "control" for t, r in ops.items() if t1 < t < t2):
            continue
        cover = sum(1 for e in events if t1 <= e < t2)
        added = sum(1 for s in (t1, t2) if s != int(s))
        key = (-cover, added, t2 - t1, t1)
        if cover and (best is None or key < best[0]):
            best = (key, t1, t2)
    if best is None:
        return []
    free = [p for p in neighbours(layout["emb"][q]) if p not in used_positions]
    return [(Flag(q, p, best[1], best[2]), -best[0][0]) for p in free]


def added_ticks(flags):
    return len({s for f in flags for s in (f.t1, f.t2) if s != int(s)})


def evaluate(inner, full, layout, flags):
    """Full validity check of a candidate; returns (row fields, valid, reason)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    emb = layout["emb"]
    v = C.check_circuit(inner, emb)  # defaults: strict, live_rule="gate", final_layer="auto"
    if v:
        return dict(reason="constraints: " + json.dumps(C.summarize(v))), False
    eq = Q.check_equivalence(inner, full, flag_qubits=tuple(layout["flags"]))
    if not eq["ok"]:
        return dict(reason="equivalence: " + json.dumps(
            {k: eq[k]["ok"] for k in ("i_code", "ii_check", "iii_reverse", "iv_deterministic")})), False
    r2 = verify(full, inner, max_fault_count=2)
    r3 = verify(full, inner, max_fault_count=3)
    rate2, rate3 = r2["error_rate_per_kept_shot"]["T"], r3["error_rate_per_kept_shot"]["T"]
    return dict(
        malignant_T_1=r2["T"][1]["malignant"], malignant_T_2=r2["T"][2]["malignant"],
        malignant_T_3=r3["T"][3]["malignant"], benign_T_2=r2["T"][2]["benign"],
        malignant_S_2=r2["S"][2]["malignant"],
        ler_T_mfc2=rate2, ler_T_mfc2_one_in=round(1 / rate2) if rate2 > 0 else "",
        ler_T_mfc3=rate3, ler_T_mfc3_one_in=round(1 / rate3) if rate3 > 0 else "",
        n_cx=len(C.two_qubit_gates(inner)), max_degree=max(map(len, C.partners(inner).values())),
        ticks=inner.num_ticks, runtime_s=round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 3), reason=""), True


# ---- main ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

FIELDS = ["id", "base_id", "m_roots", "n_qubits_tree", "k_ancillas", "tree", "labelling",
          "parity_qubits", "parity_lines", "hooks", "n_flags", "flags", "added_ticks", "n_cx",
          "max_degree", "ticks", "malignant_T_1", "malignant_T_2", "malignant_T_3", "benign_T_2",
          "malignant_S_2", "ler_T_mfc2", "ler_T_mfc2_one_in", "ler_T_mfc3", "ler_T_mfc3_one_in",
          "runtime_s", "stim_file", "full_stim_file"]
BASE_FIELDS = ["base_id", "m_roots", "n_qubits_tree", "k_ancillas", "depth", "tree", "labelling",
               "malignant_T_2_best", "malignant_T_2_hist", "ler_T_best", "hooks", "hook_free_nbrs",
               "design_rule_ok", "status", "seconds"]


def depth_of(parent, roots):
    """Fold depth of a forest {position: parent} under the ASAP schedule."""
    kids = defaultdict(list)
    for v, par in parent.items():
        if par is not None:
            kids[par].append(v)
    fin = {}

    def f(v):
        if v not in fin:
            t = 0
            for c in sorted(kids[v], key=f):
                t = max(t + 1, f(c) + 1)
            fin[v] = t
        return fin[v]

    return max(f(r) for r in roots)


def grow_forests(roots, dmax, nmax, grid=WILLOW):
    """Every forest of grid edges containing the roots (one component per root),
    no other qubit on a root's readout line, fold depth <= dmax, up to nmax
    qubits; built leaf by leaf, deduplicated by edge set. Yields parent maps."""
    lines = {readout_line(r) for r in roots}
    allowed = {p for p in grid if readout_line(p) not in lines}
    level = {frozenset(): {r: None for r in roots}}
    for _ in range(len(roots), nmax):
        nxt = {}
        for es, parent in level.items():
            for v in parent:
                for w in neighbours(v, grid):
                    if w in parent or w not in allowed:
                        continue
                    e2 = es | {(v, w)}
                    if e2 in nxt:
                        continue
                    p2 = dict(parent)
                    p2[w] = v
                    if depth_of(p2, roots) <= dmax:
                        nxt[e2] = p2
        level = nxt
        yield from level.values()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--out", default="results")
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=12)
    parser.add_argument("--dmax", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--nmax", type=int, default=12)
    parser.add_argument("--max-embeddings-per-base", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--max-valid", type=int, default=MAX_VALID)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = Path(args.out)
    (out / "option1").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    log = lambda *a: print(f"[{time.perf_counter() - t0:8.1f} s]", *a, flush=True)
    labs = labelling_classes()
    log("labelling classes", len(labs))

    # ---- the search space, grouped by (fold depth, n, m) ----------------------------
    groups = defaultdict(dict)   # (d, n, m) -> {abstract key: [Base, ...] (capped)}
    space = Counter()
    for m in (1, 2):
        for par in grow_forests(ROOTS[m], args.dmax, args.nmax):
            n = len(par)
            space[f"m{m}_forests_n{n}"] += 1
            if n < 7 + m:
                continue
            d = depth_of(par, ROOTS[m])
            for roles in role_assignments(par, ROOTS[m]):
                base = Base(par, roles, ROOTS[m])
                key = base.abstract_key()
                space[f"m{m}_d{d}_n{n}_embedded_bases"] += 1
                lst = groups[(d, n, m)].setdefault(key, [])
                if len(lst) < args.max_embeddings_per_base:
                    lst.append(base)
        log("enumerated m =", m)
    for g, keys in sorted(groups.items()):
        space[f"m{g[2]}_d{g[0]}_n{g[1]}_abstract_bases"] = len(keys)
    space = dict(sorted(space.items()))
    tot_abs = sum(len(k) for k in groups.values())
    log("space", json.dumps(space))
    log("abstract bases in the space:", tot_abs, "; x 210 labellings =", tot_abs * len(labs))
    state = dict(space=space, abstract_bases_total=tot_abs,
                 abstract_bases_x_labellings=tot_abs * len(labs), settings=dict(
                     roots=ROOTS, dmax=args.dmax, nmax=args.nmax, noise="uniformly_depolarize",
                     p=NOISE, max_fault_count=[2, 3], readout="strict", live_rule="gate",
                     final_layer="auto", max_degree=4, labelling_classes=len(labs),
                     max_embeddings_per_base=args.max_embeddings_per_base, max_valid=args.max_valid,
                     order="groups by (depth, n, m); inside a group by (best malignant T2, #hooks, LER)"))

    fh = (out / "option1_candidates.csv").open("w", newline="")
    wr = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=FIELDS)
    wr.writeheader()
    bh = (out / "option1_bases.csv").open("w", newline="")
    bw = csv.DictWriter(bh, fieldnames=BASE_FIELDS)
    bw.writeheader()
    screen = {}  # key -> dict(lab, hist, rate, hooks)
    n_valid = n_eval = n_bases = 0
    invalid = Counter()
    groups_done = []
    stop = False
    pool = Pool(args.workers)

    def checkpoint(final=False):
        state.update(n_abstract_screened=len(screen), n_bases_flag_tried=n_bases,
                     n_evaluated=n_eval, n_valid=n_valid, invalid_reasons=dict(invalid),
                     groups_done=groups_done, elapsed_s=time.perf_counter() - t0)
        if final:
            state["exhausted"] = not stop
        (out / "option1_state.json").write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=1, default=str))

    cache_path = out / "option1_screen.json"
    if cache_path.exists():  # resume
        for k, v in json.loads(cache_path.read_text()).items():
            screen[tuple(k.split("|"))] = dict(v, lab=tuple(v["lab"]),
                                               hist={int(x): y for x, y in v["hist"].items()},
                                               hooks={int(x): y for x, y in v["hooks"].items()})
        log("resumed screen cache:", len(screen))

    def save_screen():
        cache_path.write_text(json.dumps({"|".join(k): v for k, v in screen.items()}, default=str))

    # ---- phase S: screen every abstract base (best of 210 labellings, hooks) ---------
    where = {}
    for g in sorted(groups):
        d, n, m = g
        keys = groups[g]
        log(f"--- screening group depth {d}, n {n}, m {m}: {len(keys)} abstract bases")
        for i, (key, bases) in enumerate(keys.items()):
            where[key] = g
            if key in screen:
                continue
            layout = build(bases[0])
            inner = to_circuit(layout)
            light = dict(data=layout["data"])
            res = pool.map(_verify_labelling, [(str(inner), light, lab) for lab in labs], chunksize=6)
            res.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1], x[2]))
            lab = res[0][0]
            hooks = ({} if res[0][1] == INFEASIBLE else
                     hooks_of(inner, full_circuit(inner, light, lab), layout)[0])
            screen[key] = dict(lab=lab, hist=dict(sorted(Counter(r[1] for r in res).items())),
                               rate=res[0][2], hooks=hooks)
            if (i + 1) % 100 == 0:
                log(f"   screened {i + 1}/{len(keys)}")
                save_screen()
        save_screen()
        groups_done.append(dict(depth=d, n=n, m=m, abstract=len(keys)))
        checkpoint()
    best_hist = Counter(min(v["hist"]) for v in screen.values())
    state["screen_best_malignant_T2_histogram"] = dict(sorted(best_hist.items()))
    log("screen done; best-labelling malignant T2 histogram:", dict(sorted(best_hist.items())))

    # ---- phase F: flag bases in global order ------------------------------------------

8	    7 data (the d=3 colour code, as in d3a6 / G4).
9	  * Fold: every node X-collects its children by CX(node -> child), as late
10	    as its children are ready (ASAP from the leaves; one gate per qubit per
11	    TICK). Then the X parity of the whole forest = X_L sits on the roots,
12	    which are measured together (MRX, one TICK, detector = roots xor MPP).
13	    Unfold = the exact time reverse; then MX of every ancilla (each root's
14	    final MX xor its mid MRX = the time-reversed check). Ancillas are
15	    RX-prepared, the trailing layer resets them (cliffordea inner-circuit
16	    conventions, enum/circuits/main.py:42-54).
17	  * Roots: m = 1 at G4's root position (9, 9); m = 2 at G4's two measured
18	    positions (9, 9) and (8, 10), which share readout line 18. No other qubit
19	    of the forest may sit on a root's readout line (they are all live at the
20	    mid measurement); this is the "measured parity qubits have readout lines
21	    with nothing else live" rule (decision 5).
22	  * Code labelling: which data node plays which colour-code qubit. 7! = 5040
23	    labellings in 210 classes modulo the 24 code automorphisms that keep the
24	    plaquettes and the logical-S sublattice. For each abstract base the
25	    labelling with the fewest malignant 2-fault T configurations is used
26	    (all 210 verified).
27	  * Sizes: n = 7 + k qubits, enumerated by increasing n (connected vertex
28	    sets around the root(s) by Redelmeier's algorithm, then every spanning
29	    tree / root-separating spanning forest, then every data/ancilla role
30	    assignment).
31	  Translations and the r+c-line-preserving symmetries (transpose, rot180,
32	  antitranspose) do not change verify() or the readout rule, and the
33	  enumeration around a fixed root contains every orientation of every shape,
34	  so other regions differ only by Willow's boundary (free neighbours).
35	
36	FILTERS AND FLAGS
37	  * Hook qubits = qubits carrying the X/Y events of the faults with data
38	    weight >= 2 in the base's malignant 2-fault T configurations
39	    (FaultCombinator.index_to_events, enum/combinators/fault_combinator.py:374).
40	  * Design rule (decision 5): every hook qubit has a free Willow neighbour.
41	    Bases with more than 2 hook qubits are deferred (2 flags cannot cover
42	    them); they are recorded but not flagged.
43	  * Z flag (first-ex.md): fresh qubit f on a free neighbour of the hook
44	    qubit q, R in the preparation TICK (dormant in |0> until its first CX
45	    under the new live rule), CX q->f at slots t1 < t2 with q only a CX
46	    control in between (Z_q unchanged), M f in the final measurement TICK
47	    (DETECTOR on it), f in the trailing reset. Slots: existing TICKs where
48	    q is idle, or new TICKs (counted as added TICKs). Per (hook, free
49	    neighbour) the slot pair covering most hook events is used; then pairs
50	    of single flags on two different hooks (or the same hook, different f).
51	  * VALID = strict hardware constraints (nearest neighbour, degree <= 4, no
52	    reuse in a TICK, strict readout with live_rule="gate" and the checked
53	    final-layer exemption) + equivalence.check_equivalence (flags excluded
54	    from the reverse check) + verify() runs (max_fault_count 2 and 3).
55	  STOP at 20 valid flagged candidates (bases with 0 malignant 2-fault T
56	  configurations would also count, with n_flags = 0).

91	def _stab_supports(plaq):
92	    out = set()
93	    for k in range(1, 8):
94	        s = set()
95	        for i in range(3):
96	            if k >> i & 1:
97	                s ^= set(plaq[i])
98	        out.add(frozenset(s))
99	    return out

102	def code_automorphisms():
103	    s0 = _stab_supports(CODE_PLAQ)
104	    return [p for p in itertools.permutations(range(7))
105	            if {frozenset(p[q] for q in s) for s in s0} == s0 and {p[q] for q in CODE_MAJ} == set(CODE_MAJ)]

108	def labelling_classes():
109	    """210 representatives lab (code qubit j -> j-th data node) of 7! / 24."""
110	    aut = code_automorphisms()
111	    reps = set()
112	    for lab in itertools.permutations(range(7)):
113	        reps.add(min(tuple(lab[a[j]] for j in range(7)) for a in aut))
114	    return sorted(reps)

119	def connected_sets(roots, n, grid=WILLOW):
120	    """Redelmeier enumeration of connected vertex sets of size n containing all
121	    ``roots`` (several roots are treated as one merged start vertex), avoiding
122	    every other qubit on a root's readout line."""
123	    lines = {readout_line(r) for r in roots}
124	    allowed = {p for p in grid if readout_line(p) not in lines} | set(roots)
125	    nb = {p: [q for q in neighbours(p, grid) if q in allowed] for p in allowed}
126	    order = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(sorted(allowed))}
127	    start = set(roots)
128	    out = []
129	
130	    def rec(current, untried, forbidden):
131	        if len(current) == n:
132	            out.append(frozenset(current))
133	            return
134	        untried = list(untried)
135	        while untried:
136	            v = untried.pop()
137	            new = [w for w in nb[v] if w not in forbidden and w not in current]
138	            rec(current | {v}, untried + new, forbidden | set(new))
139	            forbidden = forbidden | {v}
140	
141	    init = sorted({w for r in roots for w in nb[r]} - start, key=order.get)
142	    rec(start, init, start | set(init))
143	    return out

146	def spanning_forests(vertices, roots):
147	    """Every spanning tree of the induced grid graph with the roots merged =
148	    every spanning forest whose components each contain exactly one root.
149	    Yields parent maps {v: parent or None}."""
150	    vs = sorted(vertices)
151	    rootset = set(roots)
152	    merged = lambda p: "R" if p in rootset else p
153	    edges = sorted({tuple(sorted((a, b))) for a in vs for b in neighbours(a) if b in vertices
154	                    and not (a in rootset and b in rootset)})
155	    nodes = {merged(v) for v in vs}
156	    need = len(nodes) - 1
157	
158	    def find(par, x):
159	        while par[x] != x:
160	            x = par[x]
161	        return x
162	
163	    def rec(i, chosen, par):
164	        if len(chosen) == need:
165	            yield list(chosen)
166	            return
167	        if len(edges) - i < need - len(chosen):
168	            return
169	        a, b = edges[i]
170	        ra, rb = find(par, merged(a)), find(par, merged(b))
171	        if ra != rb:
172	            p2 = dict(par)
173	            p2[ra] = rb
174	            yield from rec(i + 1, chosen + [(a, b)], p2)
175	        yield from rec(i + 1, chosen, par)
176	
177	    for es in rec(0, [], {x: x for x in nodes}):
178	        adj = defaultdict(list)
179	        for a, b in es:
180	            adj[a].append(b)
181	            adj[b].append(a)
182	        parent = {r: None for r in roots}
183	        stack = list(roots)
184	        while stack:
185	            v = stack.pop()
186	            for w in adj[v]:
187	                if w not in parent:
188	                    parent[w] = v
189	                    stack.append(w)
190	        if len(parent) == len(vs):
191	            yield parent

194	def role_assignments(parent, roots):
195	    """Roots ancilla, leaves data, internal non-root nodes data or ancilla, 7 data."""
196	    kids = Counter(p for p in parent.values() if p is not None)
197	    leaves = [v for v in parent if v not in kids and v not in roots]
198	    internal = sorted(v for v in parent if v in kids and v not in roots)
199	    need = 7 - len(leaves)
200	    if need < 0 or need > len(internal):
201	        return
202	    for data_int in itertools.combinations(internal, need):
203	        data = set(leaves) | set(data_int)
204	        yield {v: ("D" if v in data else "A") for v in parent}
