207	@dataclass
208	class Base:
209	    parent: dict      # position -> parent position (None for roots)
210	    roles: dict       # position -> "D" / "A"
211	    roots: tuple
212	
213	    def _kids(self):
214	        kids = defaultdict(list)
215	        for v, p in self.parent.items():
216	            if p is not None:
217	                kids[p].append(v)
218	        return kids
219	
220	    def canon(self):
221	        """{position: canonical string of its rooted subtree} (AHU encoding with
222	        roles); isomorphic trees get identical strings."""
223	        kids, memo = self._kids(), {}
224	
225	        def c(v):
226	            if v not in memo:
227	                memo[v] = self.roles[v] + "(" + ",".join(sorted(c(w) for w in kids[v])) + ")"
228	            return memo[v]
229	
230	        for r in self.roots:
231	            c(r)
232	        return memo
233	
234	    def nodes(self):
235	        """Circuit qubit order = canonical DFS order (roots by canonical string,
236	        children by canonical string), so isomorphic bases give the same circuit
237	        up to QUBIT_COORDS and verify() can be cached per isomorphism class."""
238	        cs, kids = self.canon(), self._kids()
239	        order = []
240	
241	        def dfs(v):
242	            order.append(v)
243	            for w in sorted(kids[v], key=lambda w: (cs[w], w)):
244	                dfs(w)
245	
246	        for r in sorted(self.roots, key=lambda r: (cs[r], r)):
247	            dfs(r)
248	        return order
249	
250	    def abstract_key(self):
251	        cs = self.canon()
252	        return tuple(sorted(cs[r] for r in self.roots))
253	
254	    def describe(self):
255	        idx = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(self.nodes())}
256	        parts = []
257	        for p in self.nodes():
258	            par = self.parent[p]
259	            parts.append(f"{idx[p]}{self.roles[p]}{p}" + ("" if par is None else f"<{idx[par]}"))
260	        return " ".join(parts)

263	def schedule(parent_idx, roots_idx):
264	    """ASAP fold: [(tick, parent, child)], depth. Children of a node are eaten
265	    in order of readiness, ties by index (= canonical order, see Base.nodes)."""
266	    n = len(parent_idx)
267	    kids = defaultdict(list)
268	    for c, p in enumerate(parent_idx):
269	        if p >= 0:
270	            kids[p].append(c)
271	    fin, gates = {}, []
272	
273	    def f(v):
274	        if v in fin:
275	            return fin[v]
276	        t = 0
277	        for c in sorted(kids[v], key=lambda c: (f(c), c)):
278	            t = max(t + 1, f(c) + 1)
279	            gates.append((t, v, c))
280	        fin[v] = t
281	        return t
282	
283	    for r in roots_idx:
284	        f(r)
285	    return sorted(gates), max(fin[r] for r in roots_idx)

292	    q: int        # control (circuit qubit index)
293	    at: tuple     # Willow position of the flag
294	    t1: float     # slot: integer = existing TICK, k + 0.5 = new TICK after TICK k

301	def build(base: Base, flags=()):
302	    """CX-form inner circuit (no detectors yet) as TICK -> ops, plus layout.
303	    TICK 0 MPP, 1 RX ancillas (+ R flags), 2..D+1 fold, D+2 MRX roots,
304	    D+3..2D+2 unfold, 2D+3 MX ancillas (+ M flags), 2D+4 R."""
305	    nodes = base.nodes()
306	    idx = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(nodes)}
307	    parent_idx = [-1 if base.parent[p] is None else idx[base.parent[p]] for p in nodes]
308	    roots = [idx[r] for r in base.roots]
309	    data = [i for i, p in enumerate(nodes) if base.roles[p] == "D"]
310	    anc = [i for i, p in enumerate(nodes) if base.roles[p] == "A"]
311	    gates, D = schedule(parent_idx, roots)
312	    ticks = defaultdict(list)  # float slot -> [(name, targets)]
313	    ticks[0].append(("MPP", data))
314	    ticks[1].append(("RX", anc))
315	    for t, a, b in gates:
316	        ticks[1 + t].append(("CX", [a, b]))
317	        ticks[2 * D + 3 - t].append(("CX", [a, b]))
318	    mid, final = D + 2, 2 * D + 3
319	    ticks[mid].append(("MRX", roots))
320	    ticks[final].append(("MX", anc))
321	    ticks[final + 1].append(("R", anc))
322	    nq = len(nodes)
323	    emb = {i: p for i, p in enumerate(nodes)}
324	    fq = []
325	    for j, fl in enumerate(flags):
326	        f = nq + j
327	        fq.append(f)
328	        emb[f] = fl.at
329	        ticks[1].append(("R", [f]))
330	        ticks[fl.t1].append(("CX", [fl.q, f]))
331	        ticks[fl.t2].append(("CX", [fl.q, f]))
332	        ticks[final].append(("M", [f]))
333	        ticks[final + 1].append(("R", [f]))
334	    return dict(ticks=ticks, emb=emb, data=data, anc=anc, roots=roots, flags=fq, mid=mid,
335	                final=final, depth=D, gates=gates, nodes=nodes)

338	def to_circuit(layout) -> stim.Circuit:
339	    """Stim circuit with detectors: forward check (roots xor MPP), then for each
340	    final MX / M the smallest deterministic set among {itself, + one root's
341	    mid record, + all roots' mid records, + MPP} (stim determinism test)."""
342	    ticks, emb = layout["ticks"], layout["emb"]
343	    c = stim.Circuit()
344	    for q in sorted(emb):
345	        c.append("QUBIT_COORDS", [q], emb[q])
346	    rec = {}  # (tick, qubit) -> measurement index
347	    n = 0
348	    for i, t in enumerate(sorted(ticks)):
349	        if i:
350	            c.append("TICK")
351	        groups = defaultdict(list)
352	        for name, ts in ticks[t]:
353	            groups[name] += ts
354	        for name in sorted(groups, key=lambda x: ("MPP", "RX", "R", "CX", "MRX", "MX", "M").index(x)):
355	            ts = groups[name]
356	            if name == "MPP":
357	                c.append("MPP", [x for q in ts for x in (stim.target_x(q), stim.target_combiner())][:-1])
358	                rec[("MPP", 0)] = n
359	                n += 1
360	            else:
361	                c.append(name, ts)
362	                if stim.gate_data(name).produces_measurements:
363	                    for q in ts:
364	                        rec[(t, q)] = n
365	                        n += 1
366	        if t == layout["mid"]:
367	            ids = [rec[(t, r)] for r in layout["roots"]] + [rec[("MPP", 0)]]
368	            c.append("DETECTOR", [stim.target_rec(x - n) for x in ids])
369	        if t == layout["final"]:
370	            mids = [rec[(layout["mid"], r)] for r in layout["roots"]]
371	            for q in layout["anc"] + layout["flags"]:
372	                m = rec[(t, q)]
373	                options = [[m]] + [[m, x] for x in mids] + [[m] + mids] + [[m] + mids + [rec[("MPP", 0)]]]
374	                for ids in options:
375	                    test = c.copy()
376	                    test.append("DETECTOR", [stim.target_rec(x - n) for x in ids])
377	                    if Q.is_deterministic(test):
378	                        c = test
379	                        break
380	    return c

383	def full_circuit(inner, layout, lab):
384	    """Full circuit for verify(): plaquettes / sublattices via the labelling
385	    lab (code qubit j -> data node lab[j])."""
386	    data = layout["data"]
387	    L = [data[lab[j]] for j in range(7)]
388	    return full_for(inner, tuple(tuple(L[j] for j in p) for p in CODE_PLAQ),
389	                    tuple(L[j] for j in CODE_MAJ), tuple(L[j] for j in CODE_MIN), data)

394	def _verify_labelling(args):
395	    inner_text, layout_light, lab = args
396	    inner = stim.Circuit(inner_text)

407	def hooks_of(inner, full, layout):
408	    """X-hook qubits: qubits carrying X/Y events of the faults with data weight
409	    >= 2 in the malignant 2-fault T configurations -> {qubit: [event ticks]}."""
410	    from cliffordea import enum
411	    m = load_measurement(full, inner)
412	    comb = enum.FaultCombinator(enum.noise.uniformly_depolarize(m.INNER_CIRCUIT, noise_level=NOISE))
413	    from cliffordea import accept
414	    an = accept.CliffordLogicalAnalyzer(data_indices=m.DATA_INDICES,
415	                                        stabilizer_generators=m.STABILIZER_GENERATORS,
416	                                        logical_s=m.LOGICAL_S)
417	    kept = comb.get_kept_effects(logical_analyzer=an, max_fault_count=2, cultivated_states=("T",))
418	    mal = [cfg for k, eff in enumerate(kept["T"]) for p, fid, cfgs in eff.values()
419	           if p > 0 and fid != 1 for cfg in cfgs if len(cfg) == 2]
420	    effect = {i: e for sig, d in comb.basis.items() for e, i in d.items()}
421	    nq = inner.num_qubits
422	    data = set(layout["data"])
423	    weight = lambda e: sum(1 for q in data if (e >> q) & 1 or (e >> (nq + q)) & 1)
424	    hooks = defaultdict(list)
425	    for cfg in mal:
426	        for i in cfg:
427	            if weight(effect[i]) < 2:
428	                continue
429	            evs = comb.index_to_events[i]
430	            single = [(ev[0], ev[2][0].value) for ev in evs if ev[1] in ("X_ERROR", "Y_ERROR")]
431	            if not single:
432	                single = [(ev[0], t.value) for ev in evs if ev[1] == "E" for t in ev[2]
433	                          if t.is_x_target or t.is_y_target]
434	            cnt = Counter(q for _, q in single)
435	            if not cnt:
436	                continue
437	            top = max(cnt.values())
438	            for q, k in cnt.items():
439	                if k == top:
440	                    hooks[q] += [t for t, qq in single if qq == q]
441	    return {q: sorted(set(ts)) for q, ts in hooks.items()}, len(mal)
442

444	def q_ops(layout):
445	    """{qubit: {slot: role}} with role control / target / other."""
446	    ops = defaultdict(dict)
447	    for t, items in layout["ticks"].items():
448	        for name, ts in items:
449	            if name == "CX":
450	                ops[ts[0]][t] = "control"
451	                ops[ts[1]][t] = "target"
452	            elif name != "MPP":
453	                for q in ts:
454	                    ops[q][t] = "other"
455	    return ops

458	def flag_options(layout, q, events, used_positions):
459	    """Best slot pair per free neighbour of q (most hook events covered,
460	    then fewest added TICKs, then shortest)."""
461	    ops = q_ops(layout)[q]
462	    lo, hi = 2, layout["final"] - 1
463	    slots = [t for t in range(lo, hi + 1) if t not in ops] + [k + 0.5 for k in range(1, hi + 1)]
464	    best = None
465	    for t1, t2 in itertools.combinations(sorted(slots), 2):
466	        if not all(r == "control" for t, r in ops.items() if t1 < t < t2):
467	            continue
468	        cover = sum(1 for e in events if t1 <= e < t2)
469	        added = sum(1 for s in (t1, t2) if s != int(s))
470	        key = (-cover, added, t2 - t1, t1)
471	        if cover and (best is None or key < best[0]):
472	            best = (key, t1, t2)
473	    if best is None:
474	        return []
475	    free = [p for p in neighbours(layout["emb"][q]) if p not in used_positions]
476	    return [(Flag(q, p, best[1], best[2]), -best[0][0]) for p in free]

480	    return len({s for f in flags for s in (f.t1, f.t2) if s != int(s)})

483	def evaluate(inner, full, layout, flags):
484	    """Full validity check of a candidate; returns (row fields, valid, reason)."""
485	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
486	    emb = layout["emb"]
487	    v = C.check_circuit(inner, emb)  # defaults: strict, live_rule="gate", final_layer="auto"
488	    if v:
489	        return dict(reason="constraints: " + json.dumps(C.summarize(v))), False
490	    eq = Q.check_equivalence(inner, full, flag_qubits=tuple(layout["flags"]))
491	    if not eq["ok"]:
492	        return dict(reason="equivalence: " + json.dumps(
493	            {k: eq[k]["ok"] for k in ("i_code", "ii_check", "iii_reverse", "iv_deterministic")})), False
494	    r2 = verify(full, inner, max_fault_count=2)
495	    r3 = verify(full, inner, max_fault_count=3)
496	    rate2, rate3 = r2["error_rate_per_kept_shot"]["T"], r3["error_rate_per_kept_shot"]["T"]
497	    return dict(
498	        malignant_T_1=r2["T"][1]["malignant"], malignant_T_2=r2["T"][2]["malignant"],
499	        malignant_T_3=r3["T"][3]["malignant"], benign_T_2=r2["T"][2]["benign"],
500	        malignant_S_2=r2["S"][2]["malignant"],
501	        ler_T_mfc2=rate2, ler_T_mfc2_one_in=round(1 / rate2) if rate2 > 0 else "",
502	        ler_T_mfc3=rate3, ler_T_mfc3_one_in=round(1 / rate3) if rate3 > 0 else "",
503	        n_cx=len(C.two_qubit_gates(inner)), max_degree=max(map(len, C.partners(inner).values())),
504	        ticks=inner.num_ticks, runtime_s=round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 3), reason=""), True

"""Option-1 task D: fold forests + mid-circuit parity-measurement qubits on Willow
(G4-type double checks), then 1-2 Z flags on the X-hook qubits.

SEARCH SPACE (a generalisation of G4's double check, in canonical CX form):
  * A base is a forest F on Willow qubits (edges = couplers) with m = 1 or 2
    components. Each component is rooted at an ANCILLA "parity-measurement
    qubit"; all leaves are data; internal nodes are data or ancillas; exactly
    7 data (the d=3 colour code, as in d3a6 / G4).
  * Fold: every node X-collects its children by CX(node -> child), as late
    as its children are ready (ASAP from the leaves; one gate per qubit per
    TICK). Then the X parity of the whole forest = X_L sits on the roots,
    which are measured together (MRX, one TICK, detector = roots xor MPP).
    Unfold = the exact time reverse; then MX of every ancilla (each root's
    final MX xor its mid MRX = the time-reversed check). Ancillas are
    RX-prepared, the trailing layer resets them (cliffordea inner-circuit
    conventions, enum/circuits/main.py:42-54).
  * Roots: m = 1 at G4's root position (9, 9); m = 2 at G4's two measured
    positions (9, 9) and (8, 10), which share readout line 18. No other qubit
    of the forest may sit on a root's readout line (they are all live at the
    mid measurement); this is the "measured parity qubits have readout lines
    with nothing else live" rule (decision 5).
  * Code labelling: which data node plays which colour-code qubit. 7! = 5040
    labellings in 210 classes modulo the 24 code automorphisms that keep the
    plaquettes and the logical-S sublattice. For each abstract base the
    labelling with the fewest malignant 2-fault T configurations is used
    (all 210 verified).
  * Sizes: n = 7 + k qubits, enumerated by increasing n (connected vertex
    sets around the root(s) by Redelmeier's algorithm, then every spanning
    tree / root-separating spanning forest, then every data/ancilla role
    assignment).
  Translations and the r+c-line-preserving symmetries (transpose, rot180,
  antitranspose) do not change verify() or the readout rule, and the
  enumeration around a fixed root contains every orientation of every shape,
  so other regions differ only by Willow's boundary (free neighbours).

FILTERS AND FLAGS
  * Hook qubits = qubits carrying the X/Y events of the faults with data
    weight >= 2 in the base's malignant 2-fault T configurations
    (FaultCombinator.index_to_events, enum/combinators/fault_combinator.py:374).
  * Design rule (decision 5): every hook qubit has a free Willow neighbour.
    Bases with more than 2 hook qubits are deferred (2 flags cannot cover
    them); they are recorded but not flagged.
  * Z flag (first-ex.md): fresh qubit f on a free neighbour of the hook
    qubit q, R in the preparation TICK (dormant in |0> until its first CX
    under the new live rule), CX q->f at slots t1 < t2 with q only a CX
    control in between (Z_q unchanged), M f in the final measurement TICK
    (DETECTOR on it), f in the trailing reset. Slots: existing TICKs where
    q is idle, or new TICKs (counted as added TICKs). Per (hook, free
    neighbour) the slot pair covering most hook events is used; then pairs
    of single flags on two different hooks (or the same hook, different f).
  * VALID = strict hardware constraints (nearest neighbour, degree <= 4, no
    reuse in a TICK, strict readout with live_rule="gate" and the checked
    final-layer exemption) + equivalence.check_equivalence (flags excluded
    from the reverse check) + verify() runs (max_fault_count 2 and 3).
  STOP at 20 valid flagged candidates (bases with 0 malignant 2-fault T
  configurations would also count, with n_flags = 0).

Usage: nohup python -m nnflags.search_option1 --workers 12 > logs/search_option1.log &
Outputs: results/option1_candidates.csv, results/option1_bases.csv,
results/option1/*.stim, results/option1_state.json (checkpoint).
"""
import argparse
import csv
import itertools
import json
import time
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from multiprocessing import Pool
from pathlib import Path

import stim

from nnflags import constraints as C
from nnflags import equivalence as Q
from nnflags.g4 import full_for
from nnflags.verify import load_measurement, verify
from nnflags.willow import WILLOW, neighbours, readout_line

CODE_PLAQ = ((0, 1, 2, 3), (1, 2, 4, 5), (2, 3, 5, 6))  # canonical d=3 colour code
CODE_MAJ = (0, 2, 4, 6)   # centre 2 + corners (S targets of logical S)
CODE_MIN = (1, 3, 5)
ROOTS = {1: ((9, 9),), 2: ((9, 9), (8, 10))}
MAX_VALID = 20
INFEASIBLE = 10 ** 6  # marker: labelling breaks the code (no flow S -> S)
NOISE = 1e-3


# ---- code labellings ------------------------------------------------------------

def _stab_supports(plaq):
    out = set()
    for k in range(1, 8):
        s = set()
        for i in range(3):
            if k >> i & 1:
                s ^= set(plaq[i])
        out.add(frozenset(s))
    return out


def code_automorphisms():
    s0 = _stab_supports(CODE_PLAQ)
    return [p for p in itertools.permutations(range(7))
            if {frozenset(p[q] for q in s) for s in s0} == s0 and {p[q] for q in CODE_MAJ} == set(CODE_MAJ)]


def labelling_classes():
    """210 representatives lab (code qubit j -> j-th data node) of 7! / 24."""
    aut = code_automorphisms()
    reps = set()
    for lab in itertools.permutations(range(7)):
        reps.add(min(tuple(lab[a[j]] for j in range(7)) for a in aut))
    return sorted(reps)


# ---- enumeration of forests ---------------------------------------------------------

def connected_sets(roots, n, grid=WILLOW):
    """Redelmeier enumeration of connected vertex sets of size n containing all
    ``roots`` (several roots are treated as one merged start vertex), avoiding
    every other qubit on a root's readout line."""
    lines = {readout_line(r) for r in roots}
    allowed = {p for p in grid if readout_line(p) not in lines} | set(roots)
    nb = {p: [q for q in neighbours(p, grid) if q in allowed] for p in allowed}
    order = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(sorted(allowed))}
    start = set(roots)
    out = []

    def rec(current, untried, forbidden):
        if len(current) == n:
            out.append(frozenset(current))
            return
        untried = list(untried)
        while untried:
            v = untried.pop()
            new = [w for w in nb[v] if w not in forbidden and w not in current]
            rec(current | {v}, untried + new, forbidden | set(new))
            forbidden = forbidden | {v}

    init = sorted({w for r in roots for w in nb[r]} - start, key=order.get)
    rec(start, init, start | set(init))
    return out


def spanning_forests(vertices, roots):
    """Every spanning tree of the induced grid graph with the roots merged =
    every spanning forest whose components each contain exactly one root.
    Yields parent maps {v: parent or None}."""
    vs = sorted(vertices)
    rootset = set(roots)
    merged = lambda p: "R" if p in rootset else p
    edges = sorted({tuple(sorted((a, b))) for a in vs for b in neighbours(a) if b in vertices
                    and not (a in rootset and b in rootset)})
    nodes = {merged(v) for v in vs}
    need = len(nodes) - 1

    def find(par, x):
        while par[x] != x:
            x = par[x]
        return x

    def rec(i, chosen, par):
        if len(chosen) == need:
            yield list(chosen)
            return
        if len(edges) - i < need - len(chosen):
            return
        a, b = edges[i]
        ra, rb = find(par, merged(a)), find(par, merged(b))
        if ra != rb:
            p2 = dict(par)
            p2[ra] = rb
            yield from rec(i + 1, chosen + [(a, b)], p2)
        yield from rec(i + 1, chosen, par)

    for es in rec(0, [], {x: x for x in nodes}):
        adj = defaultdict(list)
        for a, b in es:
            adj[a].append(b)
            adj[b].append(a)
        parent = {r: None for r in roots}
        stack = list(roots)
        while stack:
            v = stack.pop()
            for w in adj[v]:
                if w not in parent:
                    parent[w] = v
                    stack.append(w)
        if len(parent) == len(vs):
            yield parent


def role_assignments(parent, roots):
    """Roots ancilla, leaves data, internal non-root nodes data or ancilla, 7 data."""
    kids = Counter(p for p in parent.values() if p is not None)
    leaves = [v for v in parent if v not in kids and v not in roots]
    internal = sorted(v for v in parent if v in kids and v not in roots)
    need = 7 - len(leaves)
    if need < 0 or need > len(internal):
        return
    for data_int in itertools.combinations(internal, need):
        data = set(leaves) | set(data_int)
        yield {v: ("D" if v in data else "A") for v in parent}


@dataclass
class Base:
    parent: dict      # position -> parent position (None for roots)
    roles: dict       # position -> "D" / "A"
    roots: tuple

    def _kids(self):
        kids = defaultdict(list)
        for v, p in self.parent.items():
            if p is not None:
                kids[p].append(v)
        return kids

    def canon(self):
        """{position: canonical string of its rooted subtree} (AHU encoding with
        roles); isomorphic trees get identical strings."""
        kids, memo = self._kids(), {}

        def c(v):
            if v not in memo:
                memo[v] = self.roles[v] + "(" + ",".join(sorted(c(w) for w in kids[v])) + ")"
            return memo[v]

        for r in self.roots:
            c(r)
        return memo

    def nodes(self):
        """Circuit qubit order = canonical DFS order (roots by canonical string,
        children by canonical string), so isomorphic bases give the same circuit
        up to QUBIT_COORDS and verify() can be cached per isomorphism class."""
        cs, kids = self.canon(), self._kids()
        order = []

        def dfs(v):
            order.append(v)
            for w in sorted(kids[v], key=lambda w: (cs[w], w)):
                dfs(w)

        for r in sorted(self.roots, key=lambda r: (cs[r], r)):
            dfs(r)
        return order

    def abstract_key(self):
        cs = self.canon()
        return tuple(sorted(cs[r] for r in self.roots))

    def describe(self):
        idx = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(self.nodes())}
        parts = []
        for p in self.nodes():
            par = self.parent[p]
            parts.append(f"{idx[p]}{self.roles[p]}{p}" + ("" if par is None else f"<{idx[par]}"))
        return " ".join(parts)


def schedule(parent_idx, roots_idx):
    """ASAP fold: [(tick, parent, child)], depth. Children of a node are eaten
    in order of readiness, ties by index (= canonical order, see Base.nodes)."""
    n = len(parent_idx)
    kids = defaultdict(list)
    for c, p in enumerate(parent_idx):
        if p >= 0:
            kids[p].append(c)
    fin, gates = {}, []

    def f(v):
        if v in fin:
            return fin[v]
        t = 0
        for c in sorted(kids[v], key=lambda c: (f(c), c)):
            t = max(t + 1, f(c) + 1)
            gates.append((t, v, c))
        fin[v] = t
        return t

    for r in roots_idx:
        f(r)
    return sorted(gates), max(fin[r] for r in roots_idx)


# ---- circuit construction ---------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Flag:
    q: int        # control (circuit qubit index)
    at: tuple     # Willow position of the flag
    t1: float     # slot: integer = existing TICK, k + 0.5 = new TICK after TICK k
    t2: float

    def __str__(self):
        return f"q{self.q}->{self.at} t{self.t1:g},{self.t2:g}"


def build(base: Base, flags=()):
    """CX-form inner circuit (no detectors yet) as TICK -> ops, plus layout.
    TICK 0 MPP, 1 RX ancillas (+ R flags), 2..D+1 fold, D+2 MRX roots,
    D+3..2D+2 unfold, 2D+3 MX ancillas (+ M flags), 2D+4 R."""
    nodes = base.nodes()
    idx = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(nodes)}
    parent_idx = [-1 if base.parent[p] is None else idx[base.parent[p]] for p in nodes]
    roots = [idx[r] for r in base.roots]
    data = [i for i, p in enumerate(nodes) if base.roles[p] == "D"]
    anc = [i for i, p in enumerate(nodes) if base.roles[p] == "A"]
    gates, D = schedule(parent_idx, roots)
    ticks = defaultdict(list)  # float slot -> [(name, targets)]
    ticks[0].append(("MPP", data))
    ticks[1].append(("RX", anc))
    for t, a, b in gates:
        ticks[1 + t].append(("CX", [a, b]))
        ticks[2 * D + 3 - t].append(("CX", [a, b]))
    mid, final = D + 2, 2 * D + 3
    ticks[mid].append(("MRX", roots))
    ticks[final].append(("MX", anc))
    ticks[final + 1].append(("R", anc))
    nq = len(nodes)
    emb = {i: p for i, p in enumerate(nodes)}
    fq = []
    for j, fl in enumerate(flags):
        f = nq + j
        fq.append(f)
        emb[f] = fl.at
        ticks[1].append(("R", [f]))
        ticks[fl.t1].append(("CX", [fl.q, f]))
        ticks[fl.t2].append(("CX", [fl.q, f]))
        ticks[final].append(("M", [f]))
        ticks[final + 1].append(("R", [f]))
    return dict(ticks=ticks, emb=emb, data=data, anc=anc, roots=roots, flags=fq, mid=mid,
                final=final, depth=D, gates=gates, nodes=nodes)


def to_circuit(layout) -> stim.Circuit:
    """Stim circuit with detectors: forward check (roots xor MPP), then for each
    final MX / M the smallest deterministic set among {itself, + one root's
    mid record, + all roots' mid records, + MPP} (stim determinism test)."""
    ticks, emb = layout["ticks"], layout["emb"]
    c = stim.Circuit()
    for q in sorted(emb):
        c.append("QUBIT_COORDS", [q], emb[q])
    rec = {}  # (tick, qubit) -> measurement index
    n = 0
    for i, t in enumerate(sorted(ticks)):
        if i:
            c.append("TICK")
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        for name, ts in ticks[t]:
            groups[name] += ts
        for name in sorted(groups, key=lambda x: ("MPP", "RX", "R", "CX", "MRX", "MX", "M").index(x)):
            ts = groups[name]
            if name == "MPP":
                c.append("MPP", [x for q in ts for x in (stim.target_x(q), stim.target_combiner())][:-1])
                rec[("MPP", 0)] = n
                n += 1
            else:
                c.append(name, ts)
                if stim.gate_data(name).produces_measurements:
                    for q in ts:
                        rec[(t, q)] = n
                        n += 1
        if t == layout["mid"]:
            ids = [rec[(t, r)] for r in layout["roots"]] + [rec[("MPP", 0)]]
            c.append("DETECTOR", [stim.target_rec(x - n) for x in ids])
        if t == layout["final"]:
            mids = [rec[(layout["mid"], r)] for r in layout["roots"]]
            for q in layout["anc"] + layout["flags"]:
                m = rec[(t, q)]
                options = [[m]] + [[m, x] for x in mids] + [[m] + mids] + [[m] + mids + [rec[("MPP", 0)]]]
                for ids in options:
                    test = c.copy()
                    test.append("DETECTOR", [stim.target_rec(x - n) for x in ids])
                    if Q.is_deterministic(test):
                        c = test
                        break
    return c


def full_circuit(inner, layout, lab):
    """Full circuit for verify(): plaquettes / sublattices via the labelling
    lab (code qubit j -> data node lab[j])."""
    data = layout["data"]
    L = [data[lab[j]] for j in range(7)]
    return full_for(inner, tuple(tuple(L[j] for j in p) for p in CODE_PLAQ),
                    tuple(L[j] for j in CODE_MAJ), tuple(L[j] for j in CODE_MIN), data)


# ---- workers --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _verify_labelling(args):
    inner_text, layout_light, lab = args
    inner = stim.Circuit(inner_text)
    try:
        full = full_circuit(inner, layout_light, lab)
    except AssertionError:
        # The fold does not preserve the code for this labelling (m = 2: a Z
        # plaquette with odd overlap with one root's component): not a double check.
        return lab, INFEASIBLE, float("inf")
    r = verify(full, inner, max_fault_count=2)
    return lab, r["T"][2]["malignant"], r["error_rate_per_kept_shot"]["T"]


def hooks_of(inner, full, layout):
    """X-hook qubits: qubits carrying X/Y events of the faults with data weight
    >= 2 in the malignant 2-fault T configurations -> {qubit: [event ticks]}."""
    from cliffordea import enum
    m = load_measurement(full, inner)
    comb = enum.FaultCombinator(enum.noise.uniformly_depolarize(m.INNER_CIRCUIT, noise_level=NOISE))
    from cliffordea import accept
    an = accept.CliffordLogicalAnalyzer(data_indices=m.DATA_INDICES,
                                        stabilizer_generators=m.STABILIZER_GENERATORS,
                                        logical_s=m.LOGICAL_S)
    kept = comb.get_kept_effects(logical_analyzer=an, max_fault_count=2, cultivated_states=("T",))
    mal = [cfg for k, eff in enumerate(kept["T"]) for p, fid, cfgs in eff.values()
           if p > 0 and fid != 1 for cfg in cfgs if len(cfg) == 2]
    effect = {i: e for sig, d in comb.basis.items() for e, i in d.items()}
    nq = inner.num_qubits
    data = set(layout["data"])
    weight = lambda e: sum(1 for q in data if (e >> q) & 1 or (e >> (nq + q)) & 1)
    hooks = defaultdict(list)
    for cfg in mal:
        for i in cfg:
            if weight(effect[i]) < 2:
                continue
            evs = comb.index_to_events[i]
            single = [(ev[0], ev[2][0].value) for ev in evs if ev[1] in ("X_ERROR", "Y_ERROR")]
            if not single:
                single = [(ev[0], t.value) for ev in evs if ev[1] == "E" for t in ev[2]
                          if t.is_x_target or t.is_y_target]
            cnt = Counter(q for _, q in single)
            if not cnt:
                continue
            top = max(cnt.values())
            for q, k in cnt.items():
                if k == top:
                    hooks[q] += [t for t, qq in single if qq == q]
    return {q: sorted(set(ts)) for q, ts in hooks.items()}, len(mal)


def q_ops(layout):
    """{qubit: {slot: role}} with role control / target / other."""
    ops = defaultdict(dict)
    for t, items in layout["ticks"].items():
        for name, ts in items:
            if name == "CX":
                ops[ts[0]][t] = "control"
                ops[ts[1]][t] = "target"
            elif name != "MPP":
                for q in ts:
                    ops[q][t] = "other"
    return ops


def flag_options(layout, q, events, used_positions):
    """Best slot pair per free neighbour of q (most hook events covered,
    then fewest added TICKs, then shortest)."""
    ops = q_ops(layout)[q]
    lo, hi = 2, layout["final"] - 1
    slots = [t for t in range(lo, hi + 1) if t not in ops] + [k + 0.5 for k in range(1, hi + 1)]
    best = None
    for t1, t2 in itertools.combinations(sorted(slots), 2):
        if not all(r == "control" for t, r in ops.items() if t1 < t < t2):
            continue
        cover = sum(1 for e in events if t1 <= e < t2)
        added = sum(1 for s in (t1, t2) if s != int(s))
        key = (-cover, added, t2 - t1, t1)
        if cover and (best is None or key < best[0]):
            best = (key, t1, t2)
    if best is None:
        return []
    free = [p for p in neighbours(layout["emb"][q]) if p not in used_positions]
    return [(Flag(q, p, best[1], best[2]), -best[0][0]) for p in free]


def added_ticks(flags):
    return len({s for f in flags for s in (f.t1, f.t2) if s != int(s)})


def evaluate(inner, full, layout, flags):
    """Full validity check of a candidate; returns (row fields, valid, reason)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    emb = layout["emb"]
    v = C.check_circuit(inner, emb)  # defaults: strict, live_rule="gate", final_layer="auto"
    if v:
        return dict(reason="constraints: " + json.dumps(C.summarize(v))), False
    eq = Q.check_equivalence(inner, full, flag_qubits=tuple(layout["flags"]))
    if not eq["ok"]:
        return dict(reason="equivalence: " + json.dumps(
            {k: eq[k]["ok"] for k in ("i_code", "ii_check", "iii_reverse", "iv_deterministic")})), False
    r2 = verify(full, inner, max_fault_count=2)
    r3 = verify(full, inner, max_fault_count=3)
    rate2, rate3 = r2["error_rate_per_kept_shot"]["T"], r3["error_rate_per_kept_shot"]["T"]
    return dict(
        malignant_T_1=r2["T"][1]["malignant"], malignant_T_2=r2["T"][2]["malignant"],
        malignant_T_3=r3["T"][3]["malignant"], benign_T_2=r2["T"][2]["benign"],
        malignant_S_2=r2["S"][2]["malignant"],
        ler_T_mfc2=rate2, ler_T_mfc2_one_in=round(1 / rate2) if rate2 > 0 else "",
        ler_T_mfc3=rate3, ler_T_mfc3_one_in=round(1 / rate3) if rate3 > 0 else "",
        n_cx=len(C.two_qubit_gates(inner)), max_degree=max(map(len, C.partners(inner).values())),
        ticks=inner.num_ticks, runtime_s=round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 3), reason=""), True

FIELDS = ["id", "base_id", "m_roots", "n_qubits_tree", "k_ancillas", "tree", "labelling",
          "parity_qubits", "parity_lines", "hooks", "n_flags", "flags", "added_ticks", "n_cx",

               "malignant_T_2_best", "malignant_T_2_hist", "ler_T_best", "hooks", "hook_free_nbrs",
               "design_rule_ok", "status", "seconds"]


def depth_of(parent, roots):
    """Fold depth of a forest {position: parent} under the ASAP schedule."""
    kids = defaultdict(list)
    for v, par in parent.items():
        if par is not None:
            kids[par].append(v)
    fin = {}

    def f(v):
        if v not in fin:
            t = 0
            for c in sorted(kids[v], key=f):
                t = max(t + 1, f(c) + 1)
            fin[v] = t
        return fin[v]

    return max(f(r) for r in roots)


def grow_forests(roots, dmax, nmax, grid=WILLOW):
    """Every forest of grid edges containing the roots (one component per root),
    no other qubit on a root's readout line, fold depth <= dmax, up to nmax
    qubits; built leaf by leaf, deduplicated by edge set. Yields parent maps."""
    lines = {readout_line(r) for r in roots}
    allowed = {p for p in grid if readout_line(p) not in lines}
    level = {frozenset(): {r: None for r in roots}}
    for _ in range(len(roots), nmax):
        nxt = {}
        for es, parent in level.items():
            for v in parent:
                for w in neighbours(v, grid):
                    if w in parent or w not in allowed:
                        continue
                    e2 = es | {(v, w)}
                    if e2 in nxt:
                        continue
                    p2 = dict(parent)
                    p2[w] = v
                    if depth_of(p2, roots) <= dmax:
                        nxt[e2] = p2
        level = nxt
        yield from level.values()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--out", default="results")
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=12)
    parser.add_argument("--dmax", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--nmax", type=int, default=12)
    parser.add_argument("--max-embeddings-per-base", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--max-valid", type=int, default=MAX_VALID)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = Path(args.out)
    (out / "option1").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    log = lambda *a: print(f"[{time.perf_counter() - t0:8.1f} s]", *a, flush=True)
    labs = labelling_classes()
    log("labelling classes", len(labs))

    # ---- the search space, grouped by (fold depth, n, m) ----------------------------
    groups = defaultdict(dict)   # (d, n, m) -> {abstract key: [Base, ...] (capped)}
    space = Counter()
    for m in (1, 2):
        for par in grow_forests(ROOTS[m], args.dmax, args.nmax):
            n = len(par)
            space[f"m{m}_forests_n{n}"] += 1
            if n < 7 + m:
                continue
            d = depth_of(par, ROOTS[m])
            for roles in role_assignments(par, ROOTS[m]):
                base = Base(par, roles, ROOTS[m])
                key = base.abstract_key()
                space[f"m{m}_d{d}_n{n}_embedded_bases"] += 1
                lst = groups[(d, n, m)].setdefault(key, [])
                if len(lst) < args.max_embeddings_per_base:
                    lst.append(base)
        log("enumerated m =", m)
    for g, keys in sorted(groups.items()):
        space[f"m{g[2]}_d{g[0]}_n{g[1]}_abstract_bases"] = len(keys)
    space = dict(sorted(space.items()))
    tot_abs = sum(len(k) for k in groups.values())
    log("space", json.dumps(space))
    log("abstract bases in the space:", tot_abs, "; x 210 labellings =", tot_abs * len(labs))
    state = dict(space=space, abstract_bases_total=tot_abs,
                 abstract_bases_x_labellings=tot_abs * len(labs), settings=dict(
                     roots=ROOTS, dmax=args.dmax, nmax=args.nmax, noise="uniformly_depolarize",
                     p=NOISE, max_fault_count=[2, 3], readout="strict", live_rule="gate",
                     final_layer="auto", max_degree=4, labelling_classes=len(labs),
                     max_embeddings_per_base=args.max_embeddings_per_base, max_valid=args.max_valid,
                     order="groups by (depth, n, m); inside a group by (best malignant T2, #hooks, LER)"))

    fh = (out / "option1_candidates.csv").open("w", newline="")
    wr = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=FIELDS)
    wr.writeheader()
    bh = (out / "option1_bases.csv").open("w", newline="")
    bw = csv.DictWriter(bh, fieldnames=BASE_FIELDS)
    bw.writeheader()
    screen = {}  # key -> dict(lab, hist, rate, hooks)
    n_valid = n_eval = n_bases = 0
    invalid = Counter()
    groups_done = []
    stop = False
    pool = Pool(args.workers)

    def checkpoint(final=False):
        state.update(n_abstract_screened=len(screen), n_bases_flag_tried=n_bases,
                     n_evaluated=n_eval, n_valid=n_valid, invalid_reasons=dict(invalid),
                     groups_done=groups_done, elapsed_s=time.perf_counter() - t0)
        if final:
            state["exhausted"] = not stop
        (out / "option1_state.json").write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=1, default=str))

    cache_path = out / "option1_screen.json"
    if cache_path.exists():  # resume
        for k, v in json.loads(cache_path.read_text()).items():
            screen[tuple(k.split("|"))] = dict(v, lab=tuple(v["lab"]),
                                               hist={int(x): y for x, y in v["hist"].items()},
                                               hooks={int(x): y for x, y in v["hooks"].items()})
        log("resumed screen cache:", len(screen))

    def save_screen():
        cache_path.write_text(json.dumps({"|".join(k): v for k, v in screen.items()}, default=str))

    # ---- phase S: screen every abstract base (best of 210 labellings, hooks) ---------
    where = {}
    for g in sorted(groups):
        d, n, m = g
        keys = groups[g]
        log(f"--- screening group depth {d}, n {n}, m {m}: {len(keys)} abstract bases")
        for i, (key, bases) in enumerate(keys.items()):
            where[key] = g
            if key in screen:
                continue
            layout = build(bases[0])
            inner = to_circuit(layout)
            light = dict(data=layout["data"])
            res = pool.map(_verify_labelling, [(str(inner), light, lab) for lab in labs], chunksize=6)
            res.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1], x[2]))
            lab = res[0][0]
            hooks = ({} if res[0][1] == INFEASIBLE else
                     hooks_of(inner, full_circuit(inner, light, lab), layout)[0])
            screen[key] = dict(lab=lab, hist=dict(sorted(Counter(r[1] for r in res).items())),
                               rate=res[0][2], hooks=hooks)
            if (i + 1) % 100 == 0:
                log(f"   screened {i + 1}/{len(keys)}")
                save_screen()
        save_screen()
        groups_done.append(dict(depth=d, n=n, m=m, abstract=len(keys)))
        checkpoint()
    best_hist = Counter(min(v["hist"]) for v in screen.values())
    state["screen_best_malignant_T2_histogram"] = dict(sorted(best_hist.items()))
    log("screen done; best-labelling malignant T2 histogram:", dict(sorted(best_hist.items())))

    # ---- phase F: flag bases in global order ------------------------------------------
    order = sorted(where, key=lambda k: (min(screen[k]["hist"]), len(screen[k]["hooks"]),
                                         where[k][1], where[k][0], screen[k]["rate"]))
    if True:
        for key in order:
            if stop:
                break
            d, n, m = where[key]
            keys = groups[where[key]]
            sc = screen[key]
            lab, hist, rate, hooks = sc["lab"], sc["hist"], sc["rate"], sc["hooks"]
            if min(hist) == INFEASIBLE:
                continue  # no labelling makes this forest a double check of the code
            status, chosen = "design_rule_fail", None
            for base in keys[key]:
                layout = build(base)
                used = set(layout["emb"].values())
                free = {q: [p for p in neighbours(layout["emb"][q]) if p not in used] for q in hooks}
                if min(hist) == 0 or all(free[q] for q in hooks):
                    status = "zero_malignant" if min(hist) == 0 else "flagged"
                    chosen = (base, layout, used, free)
                    break
            base = chosen[0] if chosen else keys[key][0]
            layout0 = chosen[1] if chosen else build(base)
            free = chosen[3] if chosen else {}
            bid = n_bases
            n_bases += 1
            row = dict(base_id=bid, m_roots=m, n_qubits_tree=n, k_ancillas=len(layout0["anc"]),
                       depth=d, tree=base.describe(), labelling=lab, malignant_T_2_best=min(hist),
                       malignant_T_2_hist=json.dumps(hist), ler_T_best=rate, hooks=json.dumps(hooks),
                       hook_free_nbrs=json.dumps({q: len(v) for q, v in free.items()}),
                       design_rule_ok=chosen is not None, status=status, seconds="")
            if not chosen:
                bw.writerow(row)
                bh.flush()
                continue
            _, layout, used, _ = chosen
            light = dict(data=layout["data"])
            cand_groups = []
            if status == "zero_malignant":
                cand_groups.append([()])
            else:
                per_hook = {q: flag_options(layout, q, hooks[q], used)
                            for q in sorted(hooks, key=lambda q: (-len(hooks[q]), q))}
                for q, opts in per_hook.items():
                    cand_groups.append([(f,) for f, _ in opts])
                qs = list(per_hook)
                if len(qs) == 1:
                    cand_groups.append([(a, b) for (a, _), (b, _) in
                                        itertools.combinations(per_hook[qs[0]], 2)])
                for q1, q2 in itertools.combinations(qs, 2):
                    cand_groups.append([(a, b) for a, _ in per_hook[q1] for b, _ in per_hook[q2]
                                        if a.at != b.at])
            got = 0
            for cg in cand_groups:
                for flags in cg:
                    lay = build(base, flags)
                    ci = to_circuit(lay)
                    fc = full_circuit(ci, light, lab)
                    n_eval += 1
                    r, ok = evaluate(ci, fc, lay, flags)
                    if not ok:
                        invalid[r["reason"].split(":")[0]] += 1
                        continue
                    cid = n_valid
                    pth = out / "option1" / f"cand{cid:02d}.inner.stim"
                    pth.write_text(str(ci))
                    pf = out / "option1" / f"cand{cid:02d}.full.stim"
                    pf.write_text(str(fc))
                    roots_pos = [lay["emb"][x] for x in lay["roots"]]
                    wr.writerow(dict(
                        id=cid, base_id=bid, m_roots=m, n_qubits_tree=n, k_ancillas=len(lay["anc"]),
                        tree=base.describe(), labelling=lab,
                        parity_qubits=json.dumps({x: lay["emb"][x] for x in lay["roots"]}),
                        parity_lines=json.dumps(sorted({readout_line(x) for x in roots_pos})),
                        hooks=json.dumps(hooks), n_flags=len(flags),
                        flags=";".join(map(str, flags)), added_ticks=added_ticks(flags),
                        stim_file=str(pth), full_stim_file=str(pf),
                        **{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "reason"}))
                    fh.flush()
                    n_valid += 1
                    got += 1
                    log(f"VALID #{cid} base {bid} d{d} n{n} m{m} flags={[str(f) for f in flags]} "
                        f"malT1={r['malignant_T_1']} malT2={r['malignant_T_2']} "
                        f"malT3={r['malignant_T_3']} LER 1 in {r['ler_T_mfc2_one_in']}")
                    if n_valid >= args.max_valid:
                        stop = True
                    break  # at most one valid candidate per flag group
                if stop:
                    break
            row["status"] = status + f" ({got} valid)"
            bw.writerow(row)
            bh.flush()
            if n_bases % 10 == 0 or stop:
                checkpoint()
        log(f"flag phase: bases tried {n_bases}, evaluated {n_eval}, valid {n_valid}, "
            f"invalid {dict(invalid)}")
    pool.close()
    checkpoint(final=True)
    fh.close()
    bh.close()
    log("done", n_valid, "valid;", "exhausted" if not stop else "stopped at max-valid")


if __name__ == "__main__":

1	"""Generalised (multi-control) Z / X flags on G4-type fold trees (ZZ-flag round).
2	
3	A GENERALISED Z FLAG is a free Willow qubit f, prepared with R, that receives
4	CX(q_i -> f) from one or more grid neighbours q_i (tree qubits) at chosen
5	slots, and is measured with M in the final measurement layer; its DETECTOR is
6	the flag record (xor the MPP / mid-check records if needed, smallest
7	deterministic choice, checked with stim). An X FLAG is the dual: RX f,
8	CX(f -> q_i), MX f. Same-control flags (first-ex.md) and the two-control flags
9	of Chan et al.'s d3a6f2 are special cases.
10	
11	PROBES. A flag is a set of probes (q, slot, basis): CX(q -> f) at slot s reads
12	Z_q there (X flag: X_q). Slot s is an existing TICK where q is idle (integer)
13	or a new TICK inserted after TICK k (k + 0.5). cliffordea puts all noise of a
14	TICK after its operations (enum/noise/_noise.py:396-407, idle noise :408), so
15	a probe at integer slot s sees the error events of TICKs < s, a probe at
16	k + 0.5 those of TICKs <= k. Each probe is back-propagated (stim
17	PauliString.before) to the start of the double check:
18	  * through a reset / measure-reset: the component that the fresh state fixes
19	    (Z after R/MR, X after RX/MRX) is dropped, the other one becomes a random
20	    variable (tick, qubit);
21	  * at the start: data part reduced modulo the allowed stabilisers (Z flags:
22	    Z plaquettes; X flags: X plaquettes and X_L, the latter through the MPP
23	    marker record).
24	  A set of probes is a deterministic flag iff the xor of their syndromes
25	  (reduced data part + random variables) is 0. stim confirms it on the built
26	  circuit (equivalence.is_deterministic).
27	
28	COVERAGE (prefilter, exact for the base's own faults). A malignant 2-fault T
29	configuration (i, j) of the base is a pair of cliffordea fault classes
30	(FaultCombinator.index_to_events, enum/combinators/fault_combinator.py:374),
31	each a set of error events (tick, Pauli). After adding one flag, (i, j)
32	survives iff some event of i and some event of j have the same flag bit. So a
33	single flag removes (i, j) iff its bit is constant on i, constant on j, and
34	different: linear conditions over GF(2) on the probe-indicator vector x. With
35	two flags, a pair is counted as removed if one of them separates it (sufficient
36	condition; verify() decides). New faults (on the flag, on the flag CXs, and
37	idle noise in inserted TICKs) are not in the prefilter; verify() sees them.
38	
39	GEOMETRY. The grid is bipartite and a tree edge is a grid edge, so all
40	controls of one flag have the same depth parity in the tree (a flag can never
41	touch a qubit and its parent). Realisability on Willow (free grid point next
42	to all controls, degree <= 4, readout lines) is decided by an explicit
43	embedding search (``embed``) after verify().
44	"""

66	class Design:
67	    """A flag-free CX-form double check: cliffordea inner circuit + code info."""
68	    name: str
69	    inner: stim.Circuit
70	    full_args: tuple            # (plaquettes, majority, minority, data) for g4.full_for
71	    emb: dict                   # default embedding (circuit qubit -> Willow (r, c))
72	    info: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

74	    def __post_init__(self):
75	        self.layers = Q.to_layers(self.inner)
76	        self.nq = self.inner.num_qubits
77	        self.data = tuple(sorted(self.full_args[3]))
78	        self.T = len(self.layers)                     # TICKs 0 .. T-1
79	        meas_ticks = [t for t, items in enumerate(self.layers) for it in items
80	                      if isinstance(it, Q.Op) and it.name != "MPP" and it.ids]
81	        self.final = max(meas_ticks)
82	        self.mid_ticks = sorted({t for t in meas_ticks if t != self.final})
83	        self.mid_measured = sorted({q for t in self.mid_ticks for it in self.layers[t]
84	                                    if isinstance(it, Q.Op) and it.ids for q in it.targets})
85	        self.busy = defaultdict(set)                  # tick -> qubits with an op
86	        self.edges = set()
87	        for t, items in enumerate(self.layers):
88	            for it in items:
89	                if isinstance(it, Q.Op) and it.name != "MPP":
90	                    self.busy[t].update(it.targets)
91	                    if len(it.targets) == 2:
92	                        self.edges.add(tuple(sorted(it.targets)))
93	        # every qubit with an operation (a root may have no CX: a lone ancilla component)
94	        self.qubits = sorted({q for qs in self.busy.values() for q in qs} | set(self.data))
95	        adj = defaultdict(set)
96	        for a, b in self.edges:
97	            adj[a].add(b)
98	            adj[b].add(a)
99	        self.adj = dict(adj)
100	        # depth parity = grid colour of every embedding (the CX graph is a tree / forest)
101	        self.colour = {}
102	        for s in self.qubits:
103	            if s in self.colour:
104	                continue
105	            self.colour[s] = 0
106	            stack = [s]
107	            while stack:
108	                v = stack.pop()
109	                for w in adj[v]:
110	                    if w not in self.colour:
111	                        self.colour[w] = 1 - self.colour[v]
112	                        stack.append(w)
113	                    else:
114	                        assert self.colour[w] != self.colour[v], "CX graph is not bipartite"
115	
116	    def full(self, inner=None):
117	        from nnflags.g4 import full_for
118	        return full_for(self.inner if inner is None else inner, *self.full_args)

147	def parse_canon(s: str):
148	    """'A(D(),D(D()))' -> (role, [children])."""
149	    pos = 0
150	
151	    def node():
152	        nonlocal pos
153	        role = s[pos]
154	        assert s[pos + 1] == "("
155	        pos += 2
156	        kids = []
157	        while s[pos] != ")":
158	            kids.append(node())
159	            if s[pos] == ",":
160	                pos += 1
161	        pos += 1
162	        return role, kids
163	
164	    t = node()
165	    assert pos == len(s)
166	    return t

169	def base_from_key(key: str):
170	    """A Base (search_option1) with the abstract shape ``key``, embedded around
171	    Option-1's roots (where the screen found it) with nothing else on a root's
172	    readout line."""
173	    from nnflags import search_option1 as S
174	    from nnflags.willow import WILLOW, neighbours, readout_line
175	    parts = key.split("|")
176	    roots = S.ROOTS[len(parts)]
177	    lines = {readout_line(r) for r in roots}
178	    allowed = {p for p in WILLOW if readout_line(p) not in lines}
179	    trees = [parse_canon(p) for p in parts]
180	    # match tree parts to roots: try both orders for m = 2
181	    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(len(parts))):
182	        parent, roles = {}, {}
183	        used = set(roots)
184	        jobs = []  # (position, subtree)
185	        for k, r in zip(perm, roots):
186	            parent[r] = None
187	            roles[r] = trees[k][0]
188	            jobs.append((r, trees[k]))
189	
190	        def place(pending):
191	            if not pending:
192	                return True
193	            (pos, (role, kids)), rest = pending[0], pending[1:]
194	            if not kids:
195	                return place(rest)
196	            free = [w for w in neighbours(pos) if w in allowed and w not in used]
197	            for spots in itertools.permutations(free, len(kids)):
198	                for w, (crole, _) in zip(spots, kids):
199	                    used.add(w)
200	                    parent[w] = pos
201	                    roles[w] = crole
202	                if place(rest + [(w, kid) for w, kid in zip(spots, kids)]):
203	                    return True
204	                for w in spots:
205	                    used.discard(w)
206	                    parent.pop(w)
207	                    roles.pop(w)
208	            return False
209	
210	        if place(jobs):
211	            b = S.Base(parent, roles, roots)
212	            if b.abstract_key() == tuple(sorted(parts)):
213	                return b
214	    raise ValueError(f"cannot embed {key}")

219	@dataclass(frozen=True)
220	class Probe:
221	    q: int
222	    slot: float     # integer: existing TICK (q idle); k + 0.5: new TICK after TICK k
223	    basis: str      # "Z" (Z flag, CX q -> f) or "X" (X flag, CX f -> q)
224	
225	    @property
226	    def boundary(self):
227	        """Probe sees the events of TICKs < boundary."""
228	        return int(self.slot) if self.slot == int(self.slot) else int(self.slot) + 1

234	def _gf2_reduce(v, basis):
235	    for b in basis:
236	        if v ^ b < v:
237	            v ^= b
238	    return v
239	
240	
241	def _gf2_basis(vecs):
242	    basis = []
243	    for v in vecs:
244	        v = _gf2_reduce(v, basis)
245	        if v:
246	            basis.append(v)
247	            basis.sort(reverse=True)
248	    return basis

251	class ProbeAnalysis:
252	    """Probes of a design, their syndromes and their flip bits on error events."""
253	
254	    def __init__(self, d: Design, bases=("Z", "X"), half_slots=True, controls=None):
255	        self.d = d
256	        nq = d.nq
257	        self.unitary = []
258	        self.collapse = []
259	        for items in d.layers:
260	            u = stim.Circuit()
261	            col = []
262	            for it in items:
263	                if not isinstance(it, Q.Op) or it.name == "MPP":
264	                    continue
265	                gd = stim.gate_data(it.name)
266	                if gd.is_unitary:
267	                    u.append(it.name, it.targets)
268	                else:
269	                    col += [(it.name, q) for q in it.targets]
270	            self.unitary.append(u)
271	            self.collapse.append(col)
272	        data = list(d.data)
273	        bit = {q: k for k, q in enumerate(data)}
274	        plaq = d.full_args[0]
275	        vec = lambda qs: sum(1 << bit[q] for q in qs)
276	        # deterministic both in the code state (full circuit) and in cliffordea's inner
277	        # circuit, whose data start in |0>^7 with the MPP marker fixing X_L: the
278	        # intersection is span(Z plaquettes) for Z-type and {1, X_L} for X-type.
279	        self.allowed = {"Z": _gf2_basis([vec(p) for p in plaq]),
280	                        "X": _gf2_basis([vec(data)])}
281	        self.data_bit = bit
282	        self.random_index = {}
283	        self.probes = []
284	        for q in (d.qubits if controls is None else controls):
285	            slots = [s for s in range(2, d.final) if q not in d.busy[s]]
286	            if half_slots:
287	                slots += [k + 0.5 for k in range(1, d.final)]
288	            for b in bases:
289	                for s in sorted(slots):
290	                    self.probes.append(Probe(q, s, b))
291	        self.ops_at = {}       # probe -> {boundary: PauliString}
292	        self.syndrome = {}
293	        for p in self.probes:
294	            self._analyse(p)
295	
296	    def _rand(self, key):
297	        return 1 << (16 + self.random_index.setdefault(key, len(self.random_index)))
298	
299	    def _analyse(self, p: Probe):
300	        nq = self.d.nq
301	        o = stim.PauliString(nq)
302	        o[p.q] = p.basis
303	        at = {}
304	        rnd = 0
305	        for t in range(p.boundary - 1, 0, -1):
306	            at[t + 1] = o.copy()
307	            o = o.before(self.unitary[t]) if len(self.unitary[t]) else o
308	            for name, q in self.collapse[t]:
309	                k = o[q]   # 0 I, 1 X, 2 Y, 3 Z
310	                if not k:
311	                    continue
312	                fixed = 3 if name in ("R", "MR", "M") else 1 if name in ("RX", "MRX", "MX") else None
313	                if name in ("M", "MX"):  # plain measurement before the probe: treat as random
314	                    fixed = None
315	                if k != fixed:
316	                    rnd ^= self._rand((t, q))
317	                o[q] = 0
318	        at[1] = o.copy()
319	        self.ops_at[p] = at
320	        # data part at the start
321	        v = 0
322	        for q in range(nq):
323	            k = o[q]
324	            if not k:
325	                continue
326	            if q not in self.data_bit or (k != (3 if p.basis == "Z" else 1)):
327	                rnd ^= self._rand(("start", q, k))
328	            else:
329	                v |= 1 << self.data_bit[q]
330	        self.syndrome[p] = _gf2_reduce(v, self.allowed[p.basis]) | rnd
331	
332	    def flips(self, p: Probe, tick: int, pauli: stim.PauliString) -> int:
333	        """1 iff an error ``pauli`` after the ops of TICK ``tick`` flips probe p."""
334	        if tick + 1 > p.boundary or tick < 1:
335	            return 0
336	        return int(not self.ops_at[p][tick + 1].commutes(pauli))

339	def event_pauli(ev, nq) -> stim.PauliString:
340	    _, name, targets = ev
341	    ps = stim.PauliString(nq)
342	    if name not in ("E", "X_ERROR", "Y_ERROR", "Z_ERROR"):
343	        # measurement-result flip (M, MX, MRX, ...: cliffordea ONE_QUBIT_ERROR_EVENTS,
344	        # enum/constants.py:5): no Pauli on the qubits, so it flips no probe
345	        return ps
346	    if name == "E":
347	        for t in targets:
348	            ps[t.value] = "X" if t.is_x_target else "Y" if t.is_y_target else "Z"
349	    else:
350	        ps[targets[0].value] = name[0]
351	    return ps

356	def malignant_pairs(d: Design, inner=None, full=None, max_fault_count=2):
357	    """(pairs, events, comb, kept): malignant 2-fault T configurations as pairs of
358	    fault indices, and {index: [(tick, PauliString)]} for the faults in them."""
359	    inner = d.inner if inner is None else inner
360	    full = d.full(inner) if full is None else full
361	    m = load_measurement(full, inner)
362	    comb = enum.FaultCombinator(enum.noise.uniformly_depolarize(m.INNER_CIRCUIT, noise_level=NOISE))
363	    an = accept.CliffordLogicalAnalyzer(data_indices=m.DATA_INDICES,
364	                                        stabilizer_generators=m.STABILIZER_GENERATORS,
365	                                        logical_s=m.LOGICAL_S)
366	    kept = comb.get_kept_effects(logical_analyzer=an, max_fault_count=max_fault_count,
367	                                 cultivated_states=("T",))
368	    pairs = sorted({tuple(sorted(cfg)) for k, eff in enumerate(kept["T"]) for pr, fid, cfgs in eff.values()
369	                    if pr > 0 and fid != 1 for cfg in cfgs if len(cfg) == 2})
370	    nq = inner.num_qubits
371	    events = {i: [(ev[0], event_pauli(ev, nq)) for ev in comb.index_to_events[i]]
372	              for pr in pairs for i in pr}
373	    return pairs, events, comb, kept

376	# ---- coverage as a GF(2) system ---------------------------------------------------------
377	
378	class Coverage:
379	    """Flip rows of the malignant faults over a probe set, deduplicated."""
380	
381	    def __init__(self, pa: ProbeAnalysis, pairs, events):
382	        self.pa = pa
383	        self.pairs = pairs
384	        self.col = {p: k for k, p in enumerate(pa.probes)}
385	        self.rows = {}      # fault index -> set of distinct row ints (bit k = flips probe k)
386	        for i, evs in events.items():
387	            rs = set()
388	            for tick, ps in evs:
389	                r = 0
390	                for k, p in enumerate(pa.probes):
391	                    if pa.flips(p, tick, ps):
392	                        r |= 1 << k
393	                rs.add(r)
394	            self.rows[i] = sorted(rs)
395	        self.syn = [pa.syndrome[p] for p in pa.probes]
396	
397	    def system(self, cols, pair_idx):
398	        """Rows (mask over the local columns ``cols``, rhs) for: deterministic, and
399	        every pair in pair_idx separated by the flag."""
400	        def loc(r):
401	            return sum(1 << j for j, k in enumerate(cols) if r >> k & 1)
402	        eqs = []
403	        nbits = max(self.syn[k] for k in cols).bit_length() if cols else 0
404	        for b in range(nbits):
405	            m = sum(1 << j for j, k in enumerate(cols) if self.syn[k] >> b & 1)
406	            if m:
407	                eqs.append((m, 0))
408	        for pi in pair_idx:
409	            i, j = self.pairs[pi]
410	            for f in (i, j):
411	                r0 = self.rows[f][0]
412	                for r in self.rows[f][1:]:
413	                    m = loc(r0 ^ r)
414	                    if m:
415	                        eqs.append((m, 0))
416	            eqs.append((loc(self.rows[i][0] ^ self.rows[j][0]), 1))
417	        return eqs
418	
419	
420	def solve_gf2(eqs, ncols):
421	    """Gaussian elimination. Returns (particular solution, nullspace basis) or None."""
422	    piv = []   # (pivot col, mask, rhs)
423	    for m, r in eqs:
424	        for pc, pm, pr in piv:
425	            if m >> pc & 1:
426	                m ^= pm
427	                r ^= pr
428	        if not m:
429	            if r:
430	                return None
431	            continue
432	        pc = m.bit_length() - 1
433	        new = []
434	        for qc, qm, qr in piv:
435	            if qm >> pc & 1:
436	                qm ^= m
437	                qr ^= r
438	            new.append((qc, qm, qr))
439	        piv = new + [(pc, m, r)]
440	    x = 0
441	    pcs = {pc for pc, _, _ in piv}
442	    for pc, pm, pr in piv:
443	        if pr:
444	            x |= 1 << pc
445	    null = []
446	    for fc in range(ncols):
447	        if fc in pcs:
448	            continue
449	        v = 1 << fc
450	        for pc, pm, pr in piv:
451	            if pm >> fc & 1:
452	                v |= 1 << pc
453	        null.append(v)
454	    return x, null

481	def build_flagged(d: Design, flags, emb=None) -> tuple[stim.Circuit, list, list]:
482	    """Inner circuit with flags; returns (inner, flag qubit indices, flag detectors ok).
483	    Flags: prepared in TICK 1 (R / RX), probes at their slots, measured (M / MX) in
484	    the final measurement TICK with a DETECTOR (smallest deterministic choice of
485	    {flag}, {flag, MPP}, {flag, mid records}, {flag, mid, MPP}), reset in the
486	    trailing TICK. Raises ValueError if a flag detector is not deterministic or a
487	    qubit would be used twice in a TICK."""
488	    layers = [[Q.Op(it.name, list(it.targets), list(it.args), list(it.ids), it.tag)
489	               if isinstance(it, Q.Op) else (it[0], it[1], list(it[2]), list(it[3]))
490	               for it in items if isinstance(it, Q.Op) or it[0] == "det"]
491	              for items in d.layers]
492	    halfs = sorted({p.slot for f in flags for p in f.probes if p.slot != int(p.slot)})
493	    index = {}
494	    new = []
495	    for t, items in enumerate(layers):
496	        index[t] = len(new)
497	        new.append(items)
498	        for h in halfs:
499	            if int(h) == t:
500	                index[h] = len(new)
501	                new.append([])
502	    layers = new
503	    nq = d.nq
504	    fq = list(range(nq, nq + len(flags)))
505	    mpp_id = next(g for it in layers[0] if isinstance(it, Q.Op) and it.name == "MPP" for g in it.ids)
506	    mid_ids = [g for t in d.mid_ticks for it in layers[index[t]] if isinstance(it, Q.Op) for g in it.ids]
507	    fin = index[d.final]
508	    for k, (f, fl) in enumerate(zip(fq, flags)):
509	        z = fl.basis == "Z"
510	        layers[index[1]].append(Q.Op("R" if z else "RX", [f]))
511	        for p in fl.probes:
512	            layers[index[p.slot]].append(Q.Op("CX", [p.q, f] if z else [f, p.q]))
513	        layers[fin].append(Q.Op("M" if z else "MX", [f], ids=[FLAG_ID0 + k]))
514	        layers[-1].append(Q.Op("R", [f]))
515	    for items in layers:
516	        qs = [q for it in items if isinstance(it, Q.Op) and it.name != "MPP" for q in it.targets]
517	        if len(qs) != len(set(qs)):
518	            raise ValueError("qubit used twice in a TICK")
519	    # detectors, one flag at a time
520	    for k in range(len(flags)):
521	        opts = [[FLAG_ID0 + k], [FLAG_ID0 + k, mpp_id]] + [[FLAG_ID0 + k, g] for g in mid_ids] + [
522	            [FLAG_ID0 + k] + mid_ids, [FLAG_ID0 + k] + mid_ids + [mpp_id]]
523	        for ids in opts:
524	            layers[fin].append(("det", "DETECTOR", [], ids))
525	            if Q.is_deterministic(Q.from_layers(layers)):
526	                break
527	            layers[fin].pop()
528	        else:
529	            raise ValueError(f"flag {k} ({flags[k]}) is not deterministic")
530	    c = Q.from_layers(layers)
531	    if emb is not None:
532	        head = stim.Circuit()
533	        for q in sorted(emb):
534	            head.append("QUBIT_COORDS", [q], emb[q])
535	        c = head + c
536	    return c, fq

541	def _weight(v):
542	    return bin(v).count("1")
543	
544	
545	def concrete_flags(cov: Coverage, cols, pair_idx, max_null=14, limit=6):
546	    """Up to ``limit`` concrete flags (sorted by #controls, #probes, #added TICKs)
547	    realising the system for ``pair_idx`` on columns ``cols``: one probe per slot,
548	    identical columns merged (any member can stand in for its group)."""
549	    eqs = cov.system(cols, pair_idx)
550	    # merge identical columns
551	    colvec = defaultdict(int)
552	    for e, (m, _) in enumerate(eqs):
553	        for j in range(len(cols)):
554	            if m >> j & 1:
555	                colvec[j] |= 1 << e
556	    groups = defaultdict(list)
557	    for j in range(len(cols)):
558	        groups[colvec[j]].append(cols[j])
559	    keys = [k for k in groups if k]   # zero columns never matter
560	    reps = {i: k for i, k in enumerate(keys)}
561	    req = []
562	    for e, (_, r) in enumerate(eqs):
563	        m = sum(1 << i for i, k in reps.items() if k >> e & 1)
564	        req.append((m, r))
565	    sol = solve_gf2(req, len(keys))
566	    if sol is None:
567	        return []
568	    x0, null = sol
569	    if len(null) > max_null:
570	        null = sorted(null, key=_weight)[:max_null]
571	    xs = set()
572	    for bits in range(1 << len(null)):
573	        x = x0
574	        for k, v in enumerate(null):
575	            if bits >> k & 1:
576	                x ^= v
577	        if x:
578	            xs.add(x)
579	    out = []
580	    pa = cov.pa
581	    for x in sorted(xs, key=_weight)[:64]:
582	        chosen = [groups[keys[i]] for i in range(len(keys)) if x >> i & 1]
583	        if len(chosen) > 6:
584	            continue
585	        best = None
586	        for combo in itertools.islice(itertools.product(*chosen), 20000):
587	            ps = [pa.probes[k] for k in combo]
588	            slots = [p.slot for p in ps]
589	            if len(set(slots)) != len(slots):
590	                continue
591	            key = (len({p.q for p in ps}), len(ps), sum(s != int(s) for s in slots), tuple(sorted(slots)))
592	            if best is None or key < best[0]:
593	                best = (key, tuple(sorted(ps, key=lambda p: p.slot)))
594	        if best:
595	            out.append(best)
596	    out.sort(key=lambda b: b[0])
597	    seen, res = set(), []
598	    for key, ps in out:
599	        if ps not in seen:
600	            seen.add(ps)
601	            res.append(Flag(ps))
602	        if len(res) >= limit:
603	            break
604	    return res
605

607	def coverable_subsets(cov: Coverage, cols, npairs):
608	    """All subsets (bitmasks) of the malignant pairs one flag on ``cols`` can remove."""
609	    ok = {0}
610	    good = []
611	    for size in range(1, npairs + 1):
612	        for comb in itertools.combinations(range(npairs), size):
613	            mask = sum(1 << i for i in comb)
614	            if any((mask & ~(1 << i)) not in ok for i in comb):
615	                continue
616	            if solve_gf2(cov.system(cols, list(comb)), len(cols)) is not None:
617	                ok.add(mask)
618	                good.append(mask)
619	    return good

624	BULK_ROOT = (6, 7)   # every point within Manhattan distance 5 of (6, 7) is a Willow qubit

626	
627	def tree_centre(d: Design):
628	    """Node of minimum eccentricity in the CX graph (ties: smallest index)."""
629	    def ecc(s):
630	        dist, front = {s: 0}, [s]
631	        while front:
632	            nxt = []
633	            for v in front:
634	                for w in d.adj.get(v, ()):
635	                    if w not in dist:
636	                        dist[w] = dist[v] + 1
637	                        nxt.append(w)
638	            front = nxt
639	        return max(dist.values()), -len(dist)
640	    return min(d.qubits, key=lambda q: (ecc(q)[1], ecc(q)[0], q))

643	def flag_specs(inner: stim.Circuit, flag_qubits, mid_tick=None):
644	    """[(controls, live at the mid-check TICK)] of the flags of a built circuit;
645	    also {flag: [(tick, control, "Z" | "X")]} (Z: CX q -> f, X: CX f -> q)."""
646	    from nnflags import constraints as C
647	    layers = Q.to_layers(inner)
648	    meas = [t for t, items in enumerate(layers) for it in items
649	            if isinstance(it, Q.Op) and it.name != "MPP" and it.ids]
650	    final = max(meas)
651	    mid = min(t for t in meas if t != final) if mid_tick is None else mid_tick
652	    gates = defaultdict(list)
653	    for t, _, a, b in C.two_qubit_gates(inner):
654	        if b in flag_qubits:
655	            gates[b].append((t, a, "Z"))
656	        elif a in flag_qubits:
657	            gates[a].append((t, b, "X"))
658	    specs = []
659	    for f in flag_qubits:
660	        g = sorted(gates[f])
661	        specs.append((tuple(sorted({q for _, q, _ in g})), g[0][2] == "X" or g[0][0] <= mid))
662	    return specs, dict(gates)

665	def embeddings(d: Design, flags, *, root_positions=None, grid=None, limit=None):
666	    """Yield embeddings {qubit: (r, c)} of the design's CX graph plus the flags
667	    (flag k = qubit d.nq + k, adjacent to all its controls) into Willow:
668	    injective, every CX on a coupler, and no other qubit live at the mid-check
669	    measurement on the readout line of a mid-measured qubit (all tree qubits are
670	    live there; a flag is, if it is an X flag or its first probe is at or before
671	    the mid TICK). ``root_positions``: list of {mid-measured qubit: position}
672	    (default: the centre of the CX graph at BULK_ROOT; when the graph is
673	    connected and its radius is <= 4, this is exhaustive up to translation:
674	    every flag is within distance 5 of the centre and the radius-5 diamond
675	    around BULK_ROOT lies inside Willow; readout lines r + c are translation
676	    covariant)."""
677	    from nnflags.willow import WILLOW, neighbours, readout_line
678	    grid = WILLOW if grid is None else grid
679	    adj = {q: set(v) for q, v in d.adj.items()}
680	    nodes = list(d.qubits)
681	    mid = d.mid_ticks[0] if d.mid_ticks else 10 ** 9
682	    live_mid = {q: True for q in nodes}
683	    for k, fl in enumerate(flags):
684	        f = d.nq + k
685	        nodes.append(f)
686	        if isinstance(fl, Flag):
687	            ctrl, live = fl.controls, fl.basis == "X" or min(p.slot for p in fl.probes) <= mid
688	        else:
689	            ctrl, live = fl
690	        adj[f] = set(ctrl)
691	        for q in ctrl:
692	            adj.setdefault(q, set()).add(f)
693	        live_mid[f] = live
694	    roots = list(d.mid_measured)
695	    if root_positions is None:
696	        root_positions = [{tree_centre(d): BULK_ROOT}]
697	    # order: BFS from the roots (flags right after their first control)
698	    count = 0
699	    for fixed in root_positions:
700	        order = []
701	        seen = set()
702	        queue = list(fixed)
703	        while queue or len(order) < len(nodes):
704	            if not queue:
705	                queue.append(next(q for q in nodes if q not in seen))
706	            v = queue.pop(0)
707	            if v in seen:
708	                continue
709	            seen.add(v)
710	            order.append(v)
711	            for w in sorted(adj.get(v, ()), key=lambda w: (w < d.nq, w)):
712	                if w not in seen:
713	                    queue.append(w)
714	        pos = {}
715	        used = set()
716	        lines = set()
717	
718	        def ok_line(q, p):
719	            L = readout_line(p)
720	            if q in roots:
721	                return all(readout_line(pos[x]) != L or x in roots or not live_mid[x] for x in pos)
722	            return not (live_mid[q] and L in lines)
723	
724	        def rec(i):
725	            nonlocal count
726	            if i == len(order):
727	                count += 1
728	                yield dict(pos)
729	                return
730	            v = order[i]
731	            placed = [w for w in adj.get(v, ()) if w in pos]
732	            if v in fixed:
733	                cands = [fixed[v]]
734	            elif placed:
735	                cands = [p for p in neighbours(pos[placed[0]], grid)]
736	            else:
737	                cands = sorted(grid)
738	            for p in cands:
739	                if p in used or not all(abs(p[0] - pos[w][0]) + abs(p[1] - pos[w][1]) == 1 for w in placed):
740	                    continue
741	                if not ok_line(v, p):
742	                    continue
743	                pos[v] = p
744	                used.add(p)
745	                added = v in roots and readout_line(p) not in lines
746	                if added:
747	                    lines.add(readout_line(p))
748	                yield from rec(i + 1)
749	                if limit is not None and count >= limit:
750	                    return
751	                del pos[v]
752	                used.discard(p)
753	                if added:
754	                    lines.discard(readout_line(p))
755	
756	        yield from rec(0)
757	        if limit is not None and count >= limit:
758	            return
759

761	def find_valid_embedding(d: Design, flags, inner, *, max_tries=2000, root_positions=None):
762	    """First embedding (see ``embeddings``) under which ``inner`` passes the strict
763	    hardware check (constraints.check_circuit defaults). Returns (emb, n_tried,
764	    last violations) with emb None if none was found."""
765	    from nnflags import constraints as C
766	    tried, last = 0, None
767	    for emb in embeddings(d, flags, root_positions=root_positions):
768	        tried += 1
769	        v = C.check_circuit(inner, emb)
770	        if not v:
771	            return emb, tried, []
772	        last = v
773	        if tried >= max_tries:
774	            break
775	    return None, tried, last

778	def hook_qubits(d: Design):
779	    """X-hook qubits of a design (definition of search_option1.hooks_of, RESULTS_option1.md
780	    decision 6): qubits carrying the X/Y events of the faults with data weight >= 2 in the
781	    malignant 2-fault T configurations -> {qubit: [event ticks]}."""
782	    pairs, _, comb, _ = malignant_pairs(d)
783	    effect = {i: e for sig, dd in comb.basis.items() for e, i in dd.items()}
784	    nq = d.nq
785	    weight = lambda e: sum(1 for q in d.data if (e >> q) & 1 or (e >> (nq + q)) & 1)
786	    hooks = defaultdict(list)
787	    for cfg in pairs:
788	        for i in cfg:
789	            if weight(effect[i]) < 2:
790	                continue
791	            evs = comb.index_to_events[i]
792	            single = [(ev[0], ev[2][0].value) for ev in evs if ev[1] in ("X_ERROR", "Y_ERROR")]
793	            if not single:
794	                single = [(ev[0], t.value) for ev in evs if ev[1] == "E" for t in ev[2]
795	                          if t.is_x_target or t.is_y_target]
796	            cnt = defaultdict(int)
797	            for _, q in single:
798	                cnt[q] += 1
799	            if cnt:
800	                top = max(cnt.values())
801	                for q, k in cnt.items():
802	                    if k == top:
803	                        hooks[q] += [t for t, qq in single if qq == q]
804	    return {q: sorted(set(ts)) for q, ts in hooks.items()}

3	DESIGN SPACE
4	  * Bases: G4's extracted double check (CX form, results/g4/G4-CX.inner.stim)
5	    and the feasible abstract fold forests of the Option-1 screen
6	    (results/option1_screen.json, best code labelling per base), in order of
7	    best malignant 2-fault T count (then base rate).
8	  * Flags: generalised Z flags (R f, CX q_i -> f at chosen slots, M f in the
9	    final layer + DETECTOR) and, as the secondary family, X flags (RX f,
10	    CX f -> q_i, MX f). Controls of one flag: 1-4 tree qubits of the same grid
11	    colour (depth parity), each with tree degree <= 3 (it needs a free grid
12	    neighbour). Slots: existing TICKs where the control is idle, or new TICKs.
13	  * Two-level greedy search per base (exact prefilter, see zzflags.py):
14	      level 1: for every (basis, control set) every maximal set of malignant
15	               pairs one flag can remove; up to N1 concrete flags, best
16	               coverage first; each built, embedded (exists?) and verified;

18	               own faults included exactly); a second flag must remove ALL
19	               their malignant pairs (else the best partial coverages are

23	    malignant T configurations at <= 2 faults ("successes") must also pass
24	    constraints.check_circuit (strict readout, live_rule="gate",
25	    final_layer="auto"; nearest-neighbour; degree <= 4; no reuse) under a Willow
26	    embedding, equivalence.check_equivalence (flags excluded from (iii)), and
27	    get verify(max_fault_count=3).
